de dag phan tshun du brtags te smras pa/ rnam pa du ma'i brjod pa 'di ni ngo mtshar te/ slar rgyal pos ma thos kyi bar du bdag cag gis de gsal shing shel bskyon par mi nus so/ /de nas gshed ma'i skyes bu zhig log ste rgyal po la zhus so—/ /rgyal pos bkug nas dris pa/ khyod kyis 'di skad du brjod pa bden namaske/ des lha mad lags so zhes smras so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ shi ste don ci zhig 'grub par 'gyur/ des smras pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ba'o/ /rgyal bos smras pa/ gson bzhin ston pa ma thob na/ /shi nas ji ltar thob par 'gyur/ /gang las nges pa 'di skyes pa/ /ci yi don du bden par thrus/ /des rgyal po la smras pa/ lha gal te bdag smra na rab tu byung ba'i phyir bdag shi bar 'dod do/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ khyod kyis go rims bzhin du ma bstan gyis/ de ji ltar go rims bzhin du rgyas par smros shig /des ji ltar brjod pa bzhin du rang gi gtam rgyas par smras nas gsol pa / lha gzigs mdzod cig /gang las srog 'byin ༄rmel sogs thub pa sdug bsngal myong gyur pa/ /de yi thams cad gzhan don bcas shing rang min gzhan don 'jug /de ltar rig kyang gang zhig bka' la gnas par mi byed pa/ /'du shes med cing rtswa phung ༄ —dang 'dra sa yi khur bur zad/ /ston pa zhir gshegs de'i tshogs ri mo 'drar thar gyur pa'i lam/ /de yi go 'phang sems rmongs 'phel bas gtums shing sgrib 5pa na/ /phan pa ji ltar bya bar nus zhes de ltar nges pa — bheni/ /mya ngan 'das pa ji srid lta ༄ ba'i sgra 'di 3stobs med bya//gang zhig ngan 'gro sna tshogs bdag nyid gang du bkod pa dang / /gnas gtsang spangs pa'i bde 'gror yun ring ma skyes gang zhig yod/ /rnam mang gnas su 82—201

byung lkubar ma gyur sems can gang zhig yod/ /blo ldan rang gzhan de ltar mthong ba 'go ba'i phra rgyas 'grol/ /rgyal pos de'i tshig thos nas pad+ma'i sbubs ltar ngo mtshar ba'i spyan gyis smras pa/ kye bdag gi gzu lums ②su dpyad pa sngon du ma btang bar gshed ma las bka' lung sprul to④/ /phyir rgol smra bar gyur pa sna tshogs kyi/ /las dang 'bras bu lkog gyur ma mthong ngam/ /khyod kyis bden pa mthong bar gyur tam ci/ /thub ces je tshom bsams pa 'di cis 'phangs④ / /sems la sangs rgyas rjes su dran bcas khyod bsad cing / /'jig rten gnod bcas bdag gi phye'agro ba gang zhig 'gyur/ /bu gcig dga' bar mdzod cig sems dang bka' yis gyeganod bsal te/ /rim gyis lung bstan rab byung dngos po thob la shes par 'gyur/ /gsad bya gsad bya ma yin gnod dang zhi 'bras bka' dze+elung can/ /'di la pha dang ma bzhin rgyal 'bangs kun la mnga' bdag ste/ /khyod ni nga yi bhu srog sbyin pa yi kyebu yi mchog yin te/ /rjes su gnang nas rab byung zhi thob je tshom ma byed cig /bu mthong ngam/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje mchog gi ⑪ spyod pa sna tshogs mnga' ba/ bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang /rang bzhin dang / dbang po yongs su smin pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba dang /dus dang dus ma yin pa'i gnas skabs la ltos shāsprenas gdul bya la 'jug ste/nga 'di snyam du khyod la rnam par smin pa 1 nges pa'i las kyis 'phangs pa yod pas thugs rjes btang snyoms su mdzad do/ /zhes dgongs so/ /drang srong chen po gang la dus min dang / /snod min mi 'bab btang snyoms mi mdzad pa/ /de'i phyir rnam pa 'dis ni btang snyoms mdzad/ /dus dang snod dang phan 82—202

par gzigs nas gsung / /de nas rgyal pos blon po rnams la bos te smras pa/rgyal po'i khab pa rnams la 'di rgyal po'i bu yin no zhes thos rkyapar kyis shig /de nas blon po rnams kyis rgyal po'i bu la 'os pa'i gos dang / rgyan dang /phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / bran la sogs pa rnam pa sna tshogs dang / rgyal po la 'os snepa'i glang po che la bskyon nas grong khyer du bos pa/ ya mtshan can dang / thos pa dang bcas pa khyed thu rnams nyon cig /'di ni yul bā rā ṇa sī'i ④phyug po'i bu gang gā len zhes bya ba ⑤bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung bar 'dod pa na pha dang ma las gnang ⑥ba ma thob nas bdag ci nas 'jig rten pha rol du thob par 'gyur zhes de 'chi ba'i thabs gzhan rtog menas rkun mar bstan te bsad ngapar bka' lung stsal pa 'di kyeltar rigs gzhan gyis mi 'phrogs pa'i rtog mthu'i che ba'i bdag nyid sa chen po'i thig le gcig pa ḍa rgyal bar bya ba las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha ma skyes dgra'i sras su skyes so zhes thos par byas te⑪/ dga' ba dang skyo ba yang dag par skyes pa mang po phyi nas 'brang zhing mdun du byas te/ rgyal pos gnang nas smyug ma'i nags tshal gang na ba der song ngo / /de der sngon gye dus su byas pa'i rgyus bar chad thams cad zad cing nye bar grol te/ thob par rigs pa rab tu byung ba phun sum tshogs pa thob bo/ /de rab tu byung ba phun sum tshogs pa thob nas yid la byed pa phung po dang khams rab tu rnam par dbye ba rtog pa'i rim gyis kun tu sbyor ba dang / 'ching ba dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang /kun nas dkris pa thams cad kyi 3lcags sgrog gi 3'ching ba shes rab kyi ral gris yang dag par bcad nas 'jig rten thams cad kyi che ba'i che ⑪bar mchod 82—203

par bya ba 'bras bu'i mchog dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /'dir mdor ①bsdus te brjod kyi/ rgyas par ni rtogs pa brjod she pa brgya'i sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa bcu pa'i brgyad pa las blta bar bya'o / /zhutshang dpon gyi bu grags pa gzhon nu zhes bya ba la/ bcom ldan 'das bā rā ṇa sī'i ④chu bo sgrib med kyi 'gram na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe bā rā ṇa sī /phyen grags pa mchog gi rigs kyi bu zhig yod de/ nyin par bud med kyi rol mos rtse zhing dga' la yongs su spyod pa lus chad cing lus ngal te lus lci bar gyur pas gnyid log par gyur to/ /bud med de dag kyang lus chad cing lus ngal te lus lci bar gyur pas gnyid log par gyur to/ /grags pa mchog gi rigs kyi bus bud med de dag sgren mor kha sh+yachu 'dzag pa skra gol ba lag pa dag g.yengs bhupa gzhan dang gzhan gyi brdol smras byed pa dag mthong nas/ btsun mo'i 'khor de dag la dur khrod kyi 'du shes byung bar gyur te/ de nas rigs kyi bu grags pa gzhon nu mal stan chen po las babs te/ brgya stong ri ba'i mchil lham gnyis gon nas btsun mo'i grong gi phyasgo khang gang na ba der nye bar song ste/ nye bar song nas/ kye grogs po dag bdag ni rab tu gtses so/ /bdag ni nye bar gtses so zhes 'o dod bos pas kye mi ma yin pa rnams kyis ( sgo phye nas sgra mi thos par byas so/ /de nas rigs kyi bu grags pa gzhon nu tshong dus kyi sgo gang na ba der nye bar 7song ste nye bar song nas kye grogs po dag bdag ni rab tu gtses so bdag ni nye bar gtses so zhes 'o dod bos pas de mi rmyem yin pa rnams kyis sgo phye ste sgra mi grags kye par byas so/ /de nas rigs kyi bu grags pa gzhon nu grong khyer kyi sgo gang na ba der nye bar song ste/rngu nye bar song nas/ kye grogs po 82—204

dag bdag ni rab tu gtsos khyaso/ /bdag ni nye bar gtses khyeso zhes 'o dod bos pa de mi ma yin pa rnams kyis sgo phye ste sgra mi thos par byas so/ /de nas rigs kyi bu grags pa gzhon nu chu bo sgrib med kyi 'gram gang na ba snyeder nye bar song ngo / /de'i tshe na bcom ldan 'das chu bo sgrib med kyi 'gram/ phyi rol bla gab med pa na 'chag cing 'chag nas bzhugs pas rigs kyi bu grags pa gzhon nu rgyang ring po nas 'ong ba ④gzigs shing rigs kyi bu grags pa gzhon nus kyang thu bcom ldan 'das chu bo sgrib med kyi phyi rol bla gab med pa na 'chag cing 'chag par mthong nas dge sbyong bdag ni gtses h+phuso/ /kye dge sbyong bdag ni rab tu gtses so zhes 'o dod bos so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rigs kyi bu grags pa gzhon nu la 'di skad ces bka' sprul to/ /kye gzhon nu tshur shog /'di na nye bar 'tshe ba med pa dang nye bar 'tshe ba med pa'i gnas yod do/ /de nas rigs kyi bu grags pa gzhon nus brgya stong ri ba'i mchil lham zung dag chu bo sgrib med kyi ngos su dzabor nas chu bo rgal skyete bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der nye bar song ste/ nye bar song nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu grags pa gzhon nu dang gtsug lag khang gang na ba der nye bar gshegs te/ nye bar gshegs shenas gdan bshams pa la bzhugs so/ /de nas rigs kyi bu grags pa gzhon nu bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas rigs kyi bu grags pa gzhon nu bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑫ chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par dga' 82—205

bar mdzad nas gang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sngon gyi dus kyi rgyu chos kyi gtam 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i gtam dang / tshul khrims kyi gtam dang /mtho ris kyi gtam dang / 'dod pa rnams ro chung zhing nyes dmigs mang ba dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang / thar pa dang / dben pa dang / bsngags thu7pa dang / rnam par byang ba'i phyogs rgyas par yang dag par gsal bar mdzad do/ /gang gi tshe sangs rgyas 3/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de la dga' ba'i sems dang / dge ba'i sems dang / rab tu dga' ba'i sems dang / sgrib pa dang bral ba'i sems dang / 'khor ba las yang dag par 'da' ba'i chos bstan pa shes par nus shing rig ༄1pa de'i tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'khor ba las yang dag par 'das pa'i chos bstan pa 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal ba dang / kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang lam ste/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po rgyas par rab tu gsal bar mdzad do/ /'di lta ste/ gos dri ma dang bral zhing yongs su dag pa gtso ④blag mkhan gyi lag tu gtad na sreyang dag par tshon 'dzin par 'gyur ba de bzhin du rigs kyi bu grags pa gzhon nu stan la 'dug bzhin du 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi mngon par rtogs te/ 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal ba dang / kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang / lam mo/ / de nas zhwarigs kyi bu grags pa gzhon nu chos mthong ba dang / chos thob pa dang / chos rig pa dang / chos rtogs pa dang / chos la the tshom dang yid gnyis dang bral badza/ gzhan gyi rkyen gyis bkri bar bya ba ma yin pa/ ston pa gzhan gyis bstan pa'i dring mi 'jog pa/ chos la mi 'jigs pa thob nas stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 82—206

'das gang na ba de ⑫logs su thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag ni mngon par 'phags so/ /rab tu 'phags so/ / des na 1bdag bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol/ deng snyenas gzung spuste ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog dang bsdos te skyabs su 'gro zhing mngon par dang ngo / /de nas btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang nas gzhan zhig gnyid sad de bltas pa na grags pa gzhon nu rang gi khyemal stan chen po la mi snang ba mthong nas khyim bdag rigs mchog gi khang pa gang na ba der nye bar song ste/ nye bar song nas khyim bdag rigs mchog la 'di skad ces kye jo bo grags pa gzhon nu rang gi mal stan chen po la mi snang ba mkhyen par mdzod cig /ces smras so/ /de nas khyim bdag rigs mchog 'di snyam du ci grags pa gzhon nu rkun ma'am g.yon can gyis nor gyi phyir phyi rol du khyer bar ma gyur ram tshisnyam du rig sngapar byas nas/ pho nya rta pa bzhi brdzangs so/ /rang nyid lag na mar me thogs pa'i skyes bu dang lhan cig chu bo sgrib med gang na ba der nye bar song nas/khyem bdag rigs mchog gi 7chu bo sgrib med kyi 'gram du brgya stong ri ba'i mchil lham zung cig bzhag pa mthong nas de yang 'di snyam du ci gzhon nu 'di rkun ma'am g.yon can gyis 9snanor gyi phyir phyi rol du khyer bar ma gyur te/ 'di lta ste chu bo sgrib med kyi 'gram du brgya stong ri ba'i mchil lham gnyis po bzhag rkepas so//gzhon nu 'jug ngogs 'di nyid nas chu bo sgrib med brgal bar gyur te/ 'di lta ste chu bo sgrib med kyi 'gram du brgya stong ri ba'i mchil lham gnyis po 'di bzhag par byas so zhes rig nyunyupar byas nas 'jug ngogs de nyid nas chu bo sgrib 82—207

med brgal te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der nye bar song ngo bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyang ring po nas khyim bdag rigs mchog 'ong ba gzigs nas 'di snyam du gzhon nu 'di stan 'di la rmye 'dug bzhin du mi mthong bar gyur pa sade lta bu'i ngas rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba mngon par 'du bya'o snyam du dgongs nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis grags pa gzhon nu stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du khyim bdag rigs mchog gis mi mthong bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad do/ /de nas khyem bdag rigs mchog bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der nye bar song ste/ nye bar song nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das grags pa gzhon nu gang du song ba gzigs lags sam/ khyim bdag 'dug cig dang stan 'di nyid la 'dug bzhin du grags pa gzhon nu mthong bar 'gyur ba'i gnas de yod de bye /de nas khyim bdag rigs mchog 'di snyam du gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis gzhon nu mthong bar 'gyur ram snyam mo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sprul pa/khyim bdag des na gang gi tshe stan 'di nyid la 'dug bzhin du grags pa gzhon nu mthong bar 'gyur ba'i 4gnas de yod do/ /de de ltar rig 5nas dga' ba dang / yid bde ba dang / rab tu dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes te bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas khyem bdag rigs mchog bcom ldan 'das kyis phyachos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par zhes bya ba 3snga ma bzhin no/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na khyem bdag rigs mchog chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag pa skyes so/ /grags pa 82—208

gzhon nu rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan bzhin du nye bar len pa med par zag pa las sems rnam par grol lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba de slar brtul te/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di skad ces bka' mdo to / /brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing / /dul bsdams tshangs par spyod gyur cing / /sems can kun la dbyug pa spangs/ /bram ze dge spyong dge slong delku/ /de'i tshe na snyedagra bcom pa drug yod la bdun pa ni bcom ldan 'das yin no/ /khyim bdag rigs mchog gis grags pa gzhon nu stan de nyid la 'dug pa mthong ste/ grags pa gzhon nu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gzhon nu ma lus ngal ba dang / lus chad pa dang / smre sngags 'don par 'gyur gyis khyim du 'dong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag rigs mchog la 'di skad ces bka' sprul to/ /khyim bdag 'di ji ④snyam du sems—/ gang gis mi slob pa'i ye shes dang mi slob pa'i mthong bas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po mngon par rtogs kyang khyim gyi gnas su 'dug cing yongs su bsags pa'i 'dod pa la longs spyod dam/ btsun pa ma lags so/ /ji ltar khyem bdag khyod slob pa'i ye shes dang / slob pa'i mthong bas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi mngon par rtogs pa de bzhin du grags pa gzhon nu mi slob pa'i ye shes dang mi slob pa'i mthong bas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi mngon par rtogs so/ /btsun pa grags pa gzhon nus thob pa 5legs par thob ste/ mi slob pa'i ye shes dang mi slob pa'i mthong bas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi mngon par rtogs pa snelags so/ /bcom ldan 'das grags pa gzhon nu phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge slong dang rigs mchog gi khyem gang men ba der gshegs pa thugs 82—209

brtse bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das khyim bdag rigs mchog la cang mi gsung bar gnang nyusnango / /de nas khyim bdag rigs mchog bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bar gnang bar khyerig nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas te song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das nyin zhag de nyid kyi snga dro chos gos dang lhung bzed thogs te phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i pyadage slong grags pa gzhon nu dang khyim bdag rigs mchog gi khyim gang na ④ba der gshegs so/ /de'i dus na tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i btsun mo chen mo phyedang gnyis pa mdun na gnas ma zhes bya ba lam gyi bar na bcom ldan 'das nam gshegs zhes sems shing 'dug go/ /tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i btsun mo chen mo dang / mdun gnas ma gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das snergyang ring po nas gshegs pa mthong ste/ mthong nas bcom ldan 'das kyi gdan bshams te/'di ltar bcom ldan 'das bde bar gshegs sam/ bcom ldan 'das gdan bshams pa 'di la bzhugs su gsol zhes zhus te/ bcom ldan 'das gdan bshams pa la bzhugs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i btsun mo chen mo dang mdun gnas ma gnyis kyis 7zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i btsun mo gnyis po chen mo dang mdun gnas ma gnyis la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis zhes bya ba nas/ rgyas par ji srid du 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi mngon par rtogs te/ snga ma bzhin du skyabs su song zhing sems mngon par btang bye ba'i bar du'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i btsun mo chen mo dang mdun gnas ma gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /de nas 82—210

btsun pa 'dir zas kyi bya ba mdzod cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i btsun mo gnyis po chen mo dang mdun gnas ma gnyis la cang mi gsung bar gnang ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i btsun mo gnyis po chen mo dang mdun gnas ma gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das dang tshe dang ldan pa grags pa gnyis bde bar zhugs par rig nas/ gtsang zhing gya nom pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba rang gi lag nas 'drim 5rtezhing tshim par byas te/bcom ldan 'das gtsang zhing gya nom pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba rang gi lag nas tshim par brims par rig cing / khrung bzed gyu 2ba dang / stan dma' ba zhig blangs te bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du chos nyan pa'i phyir 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i btsun mo gnyis po lduchen mo dang / mdun gnas ma gnyis chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan—/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jugathu /yang dag par gzengs rgyabastod/yang dag par dga' bar mdzad nas gdan las bzhengs te gshegs so/ /mi ma yin pa rnams kyis sgo phye zhing sgra mi thos par byas te/ 'di 'ga' zhig gis kyang bsad par ma nus te/ skye ba tha ma pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'tsho byed kyang mas sgrom bur 4bcug ste rgyal po'i sgor skyur 7ba las bden pa 4mthong bar rig pas spum shi zhes gtam rgyud rgyas par 'dul ba las gos kyi gzhir blta bar bya'o/ /sogs pa'i sgras bha ba lo ba da ( ka la sogs pa srid pa tha ma pa bden pa mthong bar rigs pa dag las g.yang sar sgyur 3— yang ma shi bar dper byas pa ste/ de nyid kyi phyir ji skad bshad pa thams cad bsdu ba'i don du srid pa tha ma pa'i ⑫byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang zhes smos so / /shārte82—211

byang chub sems dpa' yum de'i 1 lhums na gnas pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i mthu dang lha'i mthus rmad du byung ba'i sems can ma'i bye mngal du zhugs pa la ji skad du/ ma ni bde zhing sems la sdig bral dang //skyes pa gzhan la 'dod pa med par 'gyur/ /khyim gyi phyogs bzhir lag na mtshon thogs pa'i/ /lha rnams bsrung ba'i don du khyab cing gnas/ /zhes bya'o/ /yang ci'i phyir mdo las btsun pa zhes bya ba ni lus thob pa ni rnam pa bzhi ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa sngar gyi skabs su bris zin to/ /bde ba skye ba zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na'o / /bde ba skye ba ni — rnam pa gsum ste/ 'di dag gis ④lus dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde bas mngon par tshim/ zhing yongs su dga' bas deyongs su khyab ste gnas so/ /de dag gi trelus la rnam pa thams cad du mi gsal ba dang ma khyab pa cung zad kyang med de/ dbe+en pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba dang yid bde ba dang spyoldan zhing tshe ring zhing dus ring mo zhig tu gnas pa'i sems can de dag yod de/ 'di lta ste/ tshangs ris kyi lha rnams te / 'di ni bde ba skye ba dang po yin no/ /'di dag ni relus ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba mngon nga/ra tshim zhing yongs su tshim la yongs su dga' bas yongs su khyab ste gnas so/ /de dag gi lus la rnam pa thams cad du mi gsal ba dang ma khyab pa cung zad kyang med de/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba dang yid bde ba dang ldan zhing tshe ring zhing dus ring mo zhig tu gnas pa'i sems can de dag yod de/ 'di lta ste 'od gsal gyi lha rnams te/ 'di ni bde ba skye ba gnyis pa yin no/ /'di dag ni kyelus 82—212

dga' ba med pa'i bde bas mngon par tshim zhing yongs su tshim la/ yongs su dga' bas yongs su khyab ste gnas so/ /de dag gi lus la rnam pa thams cad du mi gsal ba dang ma khyab pa cung zad kyang med de/ dga' ba med pa'i bde ba dang kyeldan zhing tshe ring zhing dus ring mo zhig tu gnas pa'i sems can de dag yod de/ 'di lta ste dge rgyas kyi lha rnams te/ 'di ni bde ba skye ba gsum pa yin no zhes bka' sprul to/ /sems can lus tha dad pa dag kyang yod de zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni rnam par bhushes pa gnas pa bdun du blta bar bya zhing / bcu las 'phros pa las 'don pa lta bu dang / 'di nyid du mdzod kyi gnas dang por/ de bzhin gzhan yang ci rigs par/ /zhes bya bar skye mched gnyis po zhes bya ba'i skabs su bstan pa bzhin no/ /mdo las gsum bo 'di dag ni 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid yin no zhes gsungs pa ma yin nam zhes bya ba la/ gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na'o/ /dge slong dag gsum po 'di dag ni 'dus byas 'dus byas su mtshon par byed pa ste / gsum gang zhe na/ 'dus byas bya bar yang mngon no/ /'jig ④pa dang gnas pa las gzhan du 'gyur bar yang mngon no/ /'dus ma byas ni skye bar mi mngon zhing 'jig pa dang gnas pa gzhan du 'gyur bar mi mngon no zhes bka' be+el to / / pedaper na skye ba'i 'byung ba zhes bya ba dang / mi rtag pa nyid kyis 'jig pa zhes bya ba bzhin no skyozhes bya ba la/ ji skad du/ 'du byed thams cad mi rtag ste/ /skye zhing 'jig pa'i chos can yin/ /skyes nas 'jig par 'gyur 82—213

bas na/ /de dag nye bar zhi ba bde/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /de lta yin pas rigs kyi bu dga' lhabo'i tshor ba ni rig bzhin du zhes bya ba la/ gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na'o/ /dge slong dag stobs dang ldan zhes bya ba ni/ rigs kyi bu dga' bo la yang dag par smra bas smra'i/ dge slong dag mdzes pa dang 'dod chags shas che byeb zhes bya ba ni tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo la yang dag par smra bas smra'i/ gzhan la ni ma yin no/ /dge slong dag rigs kyi bu dga' bo dbang po'i sgo yongs su bsdams shing gnas pa dang /zas kyi tshod shes pa dang / nam kyi cha stod dang cha smad la mi nyal bar sbyor ba rngul brtson par gnas pa dang / dran pa dang shes bzhin mchog dang ldan pas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du tshangs par spyod pa yongs su dag pa dang yongs su rdzogs pa spyad par nus so/ /dge slong dag de la rigs kyi bu dga' bo'i dbang po rnams kyis yongs su sgo bsdams pa gang zhe na/ dge slong dag rigs kyi bu dga' bo mig gis gzugs rnams mthong nas mtshan mar mi 'dzin la/ mngon rtags su mi 'dzin cing mig gi ④dbang po lhag par sdom pas bsdams zheshing gnas te/'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid mi bde ba sdig pa mi cedage ba'i chos rnams la sems zag dze+epa dang bral zhing de dag la 'bad pa dang / sdom zhing srung ste/mig gi dbang po la mig gi dbang po bsdams te gnas so/ /rna bas sgra dang /snas dri dang / lces ro dang / lus kyis reg bya dang / yid kyis chos rnams rnam par shes nas mtshan mar mi 'dzin cing mngon rtags su mi 'dzin la zhes bya ba nas snga ma bzhin du sdom zhing srung ste/ yid kyi dbang pos yid kyi dbang po bsdams te gnas pa'i bar du ste/ dge slong dag 'di ni rigs kyi bu 82—214

dga' bo'i dbang po'i sgo bsdams pa zhes bya'o/ /dge slong dag de la rigs kyi bu dga' bo'i zas kyi tshod shes pa gang zhe na/ dge slong dag rigs kyi bu dga' bo shes bzhin du zas za ste/ rtse ba'i phyir ma yin/ rgyags pa'i phyir ma yin/'tshag gi phyir ma yin/ rnam par brgyan pa'i phyir ma yin gyi/ ji ltar lhasrid du lus gnas shing rten pa dang / bkres pa bzlog pa dang / tshangs par spyod pa rjes su gzung 3ba'i phyir ro/ /tshor ba snga ma bzlog cing tshor ba gsar pa skyed ke par bya ba'i phyir dang / gang la stobs dang bde ba la reg pas gnas par bya ba'i phyir te/ 'di lta ste/ shing rta mkhan kyi skyes bu shing rta'i mig tu mar ram til mar skud par byed pa na rtse ba'i don du ma yin/ rgyags pa'i don du ma yin/ 'tshag gi don du ma yin/ rnam par brgyan pa'i don du ma yin gyi/ji srid du khur theg par bya ba'i don du'o/ /skyes bu sman can rma la mar ram til mar sgud par byed pa na/ rtse ba'i don du ma yin/ 'tshag gi don du ma yin / rnam par brgyan pa'i don du ma yin gyi/ ji srid du rma las thar bar bya ba'i don du'o/ /dge slong dag de bzhin du rigs kyi bu dga' bo shes bzhin du zas za bar byed ces bya ba nas snga ma bzhin du bde ba la reg par gnas pa'i phyir zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ dge slong dag 'di ni phyorigs kyi bu dga' bo'i zas kyi tshod shes pa zhes bya'o/ /dge slong dag de la rigs kyi bu dga' bo ⑪nam gyi cha stod dang cha smad la mi nyal ba'i sbyor ba la brtson par gnas pa gang zhe na / dge slong dag rigs kyi bu dga' bo nyin mo rgyu ba dang gnas pa dag la chos rnams la sems sgrib pa med cing yongs su dag go/ /de mtshan mo'i thun dang po la rgyu ba dang gnas pa dag las chos rnams la sems sgrib pa med cing 82—215

yongs su dag nas mtshan mo'i thun bar pa la gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol du rkang pa bkrus nas glo gyogayas pa phab ste/ rkang pas rkang pa mnan nas/ dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis snang ba'i 'du shes dang ldan pa'i 'du shes yid la byed cing nyal bar byed do/ /de mtshan mo'i thun tha ma la myur ba myur bar langs nas rgyu ba gnas pa dag la chos rnams la sems sgrib pa med cing yongs su dag go/ /dge slong dag 'di ni rigs kyi bu dga' bo'i nam gyi cha stod dang cha smad la mi — nyal bar spyor ba la brtson pa zhes bya'o/ /dge slong dag de la — rigs kyi bu dga' bo'i dran pa dang shes bzhin mchog gang zhe na/ dge slong dag ④rigs kyi bu dga' bo choshar phyogs su blta ba na sems thams cad dang ldan pas lta tre bar byed do/ /de gal te lho dang nub dang byang phyogs su lta mub na yang sems thams cad dang ldan pas lta hūṃbar byed do/ /de ltar lta ba 9bhen 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid mi bde ba sdig pa mi dge ba dag las sems zag pa dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag rigs kyi bu dga' bo'i tshor ba ni rig bzhin du skye'o/ /rig 71bzhin du gnas so/ /rig bzhin du nub pa dang yongs su zad pa dang yongs su gtugs par 'gyur ba de yang dran bzhin du yin gyi — ma dran bar thuni ma yin no/ /'du shes dang spyod pa rig ⑫bzhin du skye ba dang / rig bzhin du gnas pa dang / rig bzhin du nub pa dang / yongs su zad pa dang / yongs su gtugs snyepar 'gyur gyidza/ de yang dran bzhin du yin gyi/ ma dran par ni ma yin no/ /dge slong dag 'di ni rigs kyi bu dga' bo'i dran pa dang shes bzhin mchog ces bya'o/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/ 'di lta ste rigs kyi bu dga' bo ltar dbang po'i 82—216

sgo rnams yongs su bsdams te gnas pa dang / 'di lta ste/ rigs kyi bu dga' bo bzhin du rmyezas kyi tshod shes pa dang / 'di lta ste rigs kyi bu dga' bo bzhin du nam gyi cha stod dang cha smad la mi nyal ba'i spyor ba la brtson pas gnas pa dang /rigs kyi bu dga' bo bzhin du dran pa dang shes bzhin mchog dang ldan par dge slong dag kyedaga' bo la gdams pa'i zugadams ngag 'dis dga' bo bzhin du blta bar bya'o/ /de nas dge slong ④gzhan zhig gis tshigs su bcad pa 'di skad ces smras so/ /dbang po bsdams shing so sor dran ldan dang / /de bzhin zas tshod mnyam por rig pa dang / /sems kyi rgyu mtshan de 'drar rig pa dag /tshe dang ldan pa dga' bor bcom ldan gsung / /zhes smras so / / phyetshigs bcad ming la brten pa ste/ /zhes bya ba la/ gleng gzhi rgo gye mnyan du yod pa na'o/ /de nas lha gzhan zhig kha dog mngon par 'phags shing rab tu 'phags pa dang mtshan mo bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der nye bar 'ongs te / nye bar 'ongs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /da dung yang lha'i kha dog gis dze ti'i thutshal thams cad 5/snang ba rgya chen pos khyab par gyur cing phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas de'i tshe lha des tshigs su bcad pa 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshigs bcad rgyu ni ci zhig yin / /de yi dgod / pa gang zhig yin/ /tshigs su bcad pa gang la brten/ /tshigs bcad bzhi ni ci zhig yin/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sprul pa/ /tshigs bcad rgyu ni 'dod pa ste/ /de yi dgod tsoX pa yi ge yin/ /tshigs bcad ming la brten pa ste/ /tshigs bcad bzhi ni snyan ngag mkhan/ /de nas lha de bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga' zhing rjes 82—217

su yi rangs 1nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas te de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to / /④zag pa gang dag gi skye ba zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ bcom ldan 'das ko tu ba na ko tu ba'i kal ma shad dam mya na bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bos te/ dge slong dag shes pa dang mthong bas zag pa zad par nga smra'i/ mi shes pa dang ma mthong bas ni ma yin no/ /dge slong dag 'di ltar ci zhig shes pa dang mthong bas zag pa zad par nga smra'i/mi shes pa dang 3mi mthong bas ni ma yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste tshul bzhin ④ma yin pa yid la byed pa dang / tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'o/ /dge slong dag tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la mi ⑤byed na 'dod pa'i zag pa ma skyes pa skye bar 'gyur zhing skyes nas 'phel zhing rgyas par 'gyur la/ sred pa'i zag pa dang ma rig pa'i zag pa ma skyes pa skye bar 'gyur zhing skyes pa 'phel byuzhing rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag tshul bzhin yid la byed pas 'dod pa'i zag pa ma skyes pa mi skyed cing skyed 3pa spong bar 'gyur ro/ /srid pa'i zag pa dang ma rig pa'i zag pa ma skyes pa mi skyed cing 3skyes pa spong bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag byis pa so so'i skye bo thos pa dang mi ldan pa skyes bu dam pa ma mthong zhing 'phags pa'i chos la mi mkhas shing 'phags pa'i chos kyis ma dul te bye'adi ltar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin rab tu mi shes te/ bdag gi chos so zhes tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i yid la byed pas 'dod pa'i zag pa ma skyes pa skye bar 'gyur zhing / skyes pa 'phel zhing rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /srid pa'i zag pa dang ma rig pa'i ⑫ zag pa ma skyes pa skye bar 'gyur zhing skyes pa 'phel zhing rgyas 82—218

—par 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar yang bdag gis chos la tshul bzhin yid la byed pas 'dod pa'i zag pa ma skyes pa mi 1 skyed cing skyes pa spong bar 'gyur ro/ /srid pa'i zag pa dang ma rig pa'i zag pa ma skyes pa mi skyed cing skyes pa spong bar 'gyur ro zhes 'di ltar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin rab tu mi shes pas chos gang dag yid la bya ba ma yin pa'i chos de dag yid la byed cing / chos gang dag yid la bya ba'i chos de dag yid la mi byed de/ de chos gang dag yid la bya ba ma yin pa'i chos de dag yid la byed cing / chos gang dag yid la bya ba'i chos de dag yid la kyemi byed pas zhu'adi ltar 'dod pa'i zag pa ma skyes pa skye bar 'gyur zhing skyes pa 'phel ba dang ④rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /srid pa'i zag pa dang ma rig pa'i zag pa ma skyes pa skye bar 'gyur zhing byes pa 'phel ba dang rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar yang bdag gis chos la yid la byed pas 'dod pa'i zag pa ma skyes pa mi skyed 3cing skyes pa spong bar 'gyur ro/ /srid pa'i zag pa dang ma rig pa'i zag pa ma skyes pa mi skyed bhucing skyes pa spong bar 'gyur ro zhes de 'di ltar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin rab tu shes pas chos gang dag yid la bya ba ma yin pa'i chos de dag yid la snga mi byed cing / chos gang dag yid la bya ba'i chos de dag yid la byed do/ /de chos gang dag yid la bya ba ma yin pa'i chos de dag yid la mi byed cing / chos gang dag yid la bya ba'i chos de dag yid la byed pas 'di ltar 'dod pa'i zag pa ma skyes pa mi skyed kyecing skyes pa spong bar 'gyur ro/ /srid pa'i zag pa dang ma rig pa'i zag pa ma skyes pa mi skyed kyecing skyes pa spong bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag zag pa dang bcas pa gegs su gyur pa ⑪yongs su gdung ba nye bar 'khrug pa de ni rnam pa tsu1bdun te/ bdun gang zhe na/82—219

zag pa dang bcas pa mthong bas spang 1bar bya ba yang yod/ zag pa dang bcas pa bsdams pas spong ②bar bya ba yang yod/ zag pa dang bcas pa spongs ④pas spang bar bya ba yang yod/ zag pa dang bcas pa bsten pas spang bar bya ba yang yod/ zag pa dang bcas pa dul bas spang bar bya ba rjoyod/zag pa dang bcas pa bzod pas spang bar bya ba yang yod/ zag pa dang bcas pa bsgom gyepas spang bar bya ba yang yod do/ /zag pa dang bcas pa mthong bas spang bar bya ba gang zhe na/ dge slong dag byis pa so so'i skye bo thos pa dang mi ldan pa dag skyes bu dam pa ma mthong zhing 'phags pa'i chos la mi mkhas pa 'phags pa'i chos kyis mi dul ba de 'di ltar tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed de/bdag 'das pa'i dus na byung bar gyur tam/ 'on te bdag 'das pa'i dus na byung bar ma gyur/ bdag 'das pa'i dus na ci 'dra bar byung / bdag 'das pa'i dus na ji ltar byung bar gyur zhes bya ba dang / phyi ma'i mtha'i rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur te/ bdag ma 'ongs pa'i dus na 'byung bar 'gyur ram/'on te ma 'ongs pa'i dus na 'byung bar mi 'gyur/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na ci 'dra bar 'byung bar 'gyur/ ma 'ongs pa sdom pas bsdams pa /6zhes bya'o/ /zag pa dang bcas pa spangs pas spong kyebar bya ba gang zhe na/ dge slong dag 'di la glang po che smyon pa thag ring du yongs su spang bar bya zhing / khyi smyon pa dang / kyebardung ba dang / rta rgod dang / gnas mi shes pa dang / ngam grog dang / mtsho dang / g.yang sa dang / shing rta dang / ljan ljin dang /sdig pa can dang / tha chad dang / sdig pa can gyi grogs po dang / sdig pa can kyi mal cha dang / stan dang / mal cha dang stan 'di lta bu la yongs 82—220

su zhen pa mkhas pa tshangs par spyod pas mi srid pa srid par 'gyur ba dang /brtag par bya ba ma yin pa rtog par byed pa de lta bu'i mal cha dang stan ring du yongs su spang bar ①bya ste/ spangs na zag pa dang / gegs dang / yongs su gdung ba dang / 'khrug pa skye bar yongs su spang bar byebya ste/ 'di ltar zag pa dang / gegs dang / yongs su gdung ba dang / 'khrug pa mi skye ba 'di ni spangs pas spang bar bya ba zhes bya'o/ /zag pa dang bcas pa bsten pas spang bar bya ba gang zhe na/ 'di la dge slong so sor brtags thunas chos gos gyon ④par byed kyi rtse ba'i phyir ma yin rgyags pa'i phyir ma yin/ 'tshag gi phyir ma yin/ brgyan pa'i phyir ma yin gyi/ ji srid du sbrang bu dang / sha sbrang dang / rlung dang / tsha ba dang / sdig sbrul gyi reg pa gzhom par bya ba'i phyir dang / ngo tsha ba dang gsang ba'i gnas dgab par bya ba'i phyir gon par byed do/ /so sor brtags thunas bsod snyoms bsten par byed kyi rtsed mo'i bye phyir ma yin/ rgyags pa'i phyir ma yin/ 'tshag gi phyir ma yin/brgyan pa'i phyir ma yin gyi ji srid du hūṃlus 'di gnas pa dang mi bsgom pa dang /bkres pa bsal ba dang / tshangs par spyod pa la srerjes su bzung rmyeb dang /tshor ba rnying pa rnams bsal zhing — — tshor ba gsar pa bskyed nyu2par bya ba'i phyir dang / 'tsho bar 'gyur ba dang / stobs dang / bde ba la reg par gnas par bya ba'i don du'o/ /so sor brtags te mal cha dang stan la nyal bar byed de/rtse ba'i phyir ma yin/ rgyags pa'i phyir ma yin/ 'tshag gi phyir ma yin/brgyan pa'i phyir ma yin gyi/ ji phyasrid du tha mal pa'i yongs su 'jig pa rnams gzhom pa dang / mnyam 3 par gzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /de rngu so sor brtags te 82—221

na ba'i gsos sman sten ①par byeng/ de/ rtse ba'i phyir ma yin/ rnam par brgyan pa'i phyir ma yin gyi/ ji srid du lus kyi tshor ba sdug bsngal ba drag pa rtsub pa gnad gcod pa yid du mi 'ong ba ②srog 'phrog par byed pa bsal zhing dga' ba dang ldan par bya ba'i don du'o/ /gang zhig so sor ma bstan na gzag pa dang bcas pa ④gegs yongs su gdung ba dang nye bar 'khrug pa mi skye ba 'di ni so sor bsten rngupas spang bar bya ba zhes bya'o/ /zag pa dang bcas pa dul bas spang bar bya ba gang zhe na/ 'di la dge slong 'dod pa'i rnam par rtog pa skyes pa mi bzod cing spong zhing bsring ⑥la thag ring du byed pa dang / gnod sems kyi rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par 'tshe ba'i rnam par rtog pa skyes pa mi spyobazod cing spong la snyebasring ba dang thag ring du byed cing 'dul ba/ zag pa dang / gegs spudang / yongs su gdung ba dang / nye bar 'khrug pa skyes pa 'dul bar byed cing 'di ltar mi skye bar byed parmye/ zag pa dang / gegs dang / yongs su gdung ba dang / nye bar 'khrug pa 'dul bar byed pas sdom pa zhes bya'o/ /zag pa dang bcas pa bzod pas spang bar bya ba gang zhe na/'di la dge slong dge ba'i chos rnams la brtson 'grus brtsams zhing ⑪gnas te/stobs dang ldan pa'i brtson 'grus dang / spro ba dang / brtan pa dang pha rol gnon pa khur mi 'dor ba gang gis shā pags pa dang / rtsa rgyus dang / rus pa tsam zhig lus shing lus kyi sha dang / khrag skams 8kyang dge ba'i chos rnams la brtson 'grus rtsom pa gang dang / stobs dang ldan pa'i brtson 'grus tshadang /spyo ba dang / brtan pa dang / pha rol gnon pa dang / khur mi 'dor ba gang gis thob par bya ba ma thob pa de srid du brtson 'grus rtsom skyepar 'gyur 82—222

te—/ de 'di snyam du brtson 'grus brtsams shing gnas nas lus ngal ba skyes sam/sems ngal lam/ lus dang sems la rims nad byung ngam/ lus dang sems yongs su gdung ba'am/ lus dang sems yongs su 'khrug pa skyes kyang tshe dang ldan pa de de'i rgyus brtson pa yongs su mi 'dor ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa de bkres pa dang skom pa dang / sbrang bu dang / sha sbrang dang / rlung dang / tsha ba dang / sdig sbrul gyi blureg pa dang / gzhan gyis shes par smras pa dang /nyes par brjod pa'i tshig gi 1lam rnams bzod cing / lus kyi tshor ba sdug bsngal ba drag pa rtsub pa gnad gcod pa yid du mi 3'ong ba srog 'phrog par byed pa skyes shing skyes pa bzod par 'gyur zhing bzod pa bskyed do/ /gang zhig mi bzod na zag pa dang bcas pa gegs yongs su gdung ba nye bar 'khrug pa skye bar 'gyur ba de 'di ltar bzod na zag pa dang bcas pa gegs yongs su gdung ba nye bar 'khrug pa skye bar mi 'gyur ba 'di ni zag pa dang bcas pa bzod pas spang bar bya ba zhes bya'o/ /zag pa dang bcas pa bsgom pas spang bar bya ba gang zhe na / 'di la dge slong nye bar len pa dang bcas pa'i phung po lnga rnams la skye ba dang 'jig pa'i chos can du rjes su lta zhing gnas te/ 'di lta ste/ 'di ni gzugs so/ /'di ni gzugs kun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni gzugs 'gog pa'o//'di ni tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / 'di ni spurnam par shes pa'o/ /'di ni rnam par shes pa kun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni rnam par shes pa 'gog pa'o zhes de nye bar len pa dang bcas pa'i phung po lnga po 'di nyid la skye ba dang ṭu'ajig pa'i chos can du rjes su lta 3zhing gnas te/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dngen pa la gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang bral 82—223

ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas kyeyongs su bsgyur bar khye sgom par byed do/ /chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa dang /brtson 'grus dang / dga' ba dang / shin tu sbyangs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / btang snyoms byang chub kyi yan lag dben pa la gnas pa 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa 'gog pa la gnas pa rnam par spong ba yongs su bsgyur ba sgom byepar byed de/ gang zhig ma bsgoms ④ na skye bar 'gyur ba'i zag pa dang / gegs dang yongs su gdung ba dang nye bar 'khrug pa de dag 'di ltar bsgoms phyepas zag pa dang gegs dang ⑥yongs su gdung ba dang 'khrug pa skye bar mi 'gyur te/ 'di ni zag pa dang bcas pa bsgom pas spang bar bya ba zhes bya'o//de ltar na dge slong zag pa dang bcas pa gang dag mthong bas spang bar bya ba de dag mthong bas spong bar 'gyur ro/ /zag pa dang bcas pa gang dag bsdams pas spang bar bya ba de dag bsdams pas yongs su 4spong bar 'gyur ro/ /zag pa dang bcas pa gang dag yongs su spangs pas dāspang bar bya ba de dag yongs su spangs pas spang ngo / /zag pa dang bcas pa gang dag so sor bsten sh+yi pas spang bar bya ba de dag so sor bsten nyuḥpas spong ngo / /zag pa dang bcas pa gang dag dul bas spang bar bya ba de dag dul bas spong bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /zag pa dang bcas pa gang dag bzod pas spang bar bya ba de dag bzod pas spang tsubar byed do/ /zag pa dang bcas pa gang dag bsgom pas spang bar bya ba de dag bsgom pas 15yongs su spong bar 'gyur ba 'di ni dge slong zag pa thams cad las sems rab tu bsdams pa zhes brjod de/ srid pa chad pa dang kye kun du sbyor ba spangs pa/ yang dag pa'i ye shes kyis sdug bsngal mthar byed par 82—224

'gyur ro zhes bka' sprul to/ /de ltar na rab tu byed pa'i gzhung zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ rab tu byed pa las dri ba stong 'byung ba las 'phags pa'i bden pa rnam par dbye ba'i mdo'i 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rmedri ba dang lan las ji skad du 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu can yin la 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu ma yin pa ni du/ 'jig tshogs la —lta ba'i rgyu yin la 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu can ma yin pa ni du/'jig tshogs la lta ba'i kyergyu can yang yin la 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu yang yin pa ni du/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu can yang ma yin la 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu yang ma yin pa ni du zhe na zhes dri ba bkod nas lan btab pa④/gnyis ni 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu can yang ma yin la 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu yang ma yin no/ /gnyis la ni bye brag yod de sdug bsngal gyi bden pa dang kun 'byung ba ni 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu can yang yin la 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu ma yin te/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu can yang yin la 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu yang yin pa 5dang / 'gog pa dang lam gyi bden pa ni 'jig ⑥tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu can yang ma yin la dze+e'ajig tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu yang ma yin pas so/ /de la 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu can yin la 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu ma yin pa ni 'das pa dang da ltar byung ba'i snyug bsngal mthong bas spang bar bya ba'i phra rgyas rnams dang / de dag dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sdug bsngal gyi bden pa ma gtogs pa dang / 'jig tshogs la lta ba dang / de dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i chos rnams kyi skye ba dang / rga ba dang / gnas pa dang / mi rtag pa ma gtogs pa de las gzhan pa sbug bsngal kyi bden pa nyon mongs pa can 82—225

gang yin pa 'di ni 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu can yin la 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu ma yin pa zhes bya'o/ /'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu yang yin la 'jig tshogs la lhalta ba'i rgyu can yang yin pa ni gang dag ma gtogs pa rnams so/ /'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu can yang ma yin la 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu yang ma yin pa ni sdug bsngal gyi bden pa nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa ste/ 'di ltar sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gi bden pa'o / /sa gzugs bskyed pa'i rgyu gang yin pa dang rkyen gang — yin pa de dag kyang zhes bya ba la/ gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na'o/ /dge slong dag gzugs bskyed pa'i rgyu gang yin pa dang / rkyen gang yin pa de dag kyang mi rtag na/rgyu dang rkyen mi rtag pa la 4brten nas byung ba'i gzugs la rtag phyepar ga la 'gyur / tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa bskyed pa'i rgyu gang yin pa dang / rkyen gang yin pa de dag kyang mi rtag na rgyu dang rkyen mi rtag pa la trebarten te skyes pa'i rnam par shes pa lta rtag par ga la 'gyur/ dge slong dag gzugs mi rtag pa tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa ni mi rtag pa ste/ gang mi rtag pa de dzasdug bsngal ba/ gang sdug bsngal ba de bdag med pa/ gang bdag med pa de thams cad nga'i med pa/ nga yir bya ba med pa/ bdag gi bdag tu bya ba med pa/ 'di lta ste/ yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis blta bhe bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag de ltar mthong ba'i 'phags pa nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa gzugs la yid 'byung zhing / tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa la yid 'byung bar 'gyur ro / /gang yid 'byung ba de 'dod chags dang bral lo/ /'dod chags dang 82—226

bral na grol bar 'gyur ro/ /grol na rnam par grol ba'i ye shes dang mthong bas bdag gi hūṃskye ba zad do/ /tshangs par spyod pa bsten khyeto/ /bya ba byas so/ /srid pa 'di las gzhan mi shes so zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes bka' sprul to / /༷ sbug bsngal spangs par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i mdo 'di ji ltar drang zhe na zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na'o/ /dbang po lnga po 'di dag kun du bsten goms par byas lan mang du byas nas 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sdug bsngal spangs par 'gyur zhing mi 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /lnga gang zhe na/ dge slong dag dad pa'i dbang po kun du bstan ④goms par byas lan mang du byas na 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sdug bsngal spangs shing mi 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /brtson 'grus kyi dbang po dang / dran pa'i dbang po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po dang /shes rab kyi dbang po kun du bsten goms par byas lan mang du byas na 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sdug bsngal spangs par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so / /snyegazugs la 'dun pa dang 'dod chags gang yin pa de spongs shig ces bya ba la sogs pa la/ gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na'o/ /dge slong dag gzugs la 'dun pa dang 'dod chags gang yin pa de spongs shig /'dun pa dang 'dod chags spangs na khyed kyis gzugs de lta bu yang spangs skyepa dang /yongs su shes par yang 'gyur te shing ta 7la rtsa ba bcad pa bzhin du mi snang ba dang phyis mi skye ba'i chos can du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa la 'dun pa dang 'dod 82—227

chags gang yin pa de spongs shig /'dun pa dang 'dod chags spangs na khyod kyis 'dun pa dang 'dod chags yongs shes pa dang 1yongs su spangs par tsosna'agyur te/ shing ta lkul rtsa ba bcad pa bzhin du mi ④snang ba dang phyis yongs su mi skye ba'i chos can du 'gyur ro zhes bka' stsal to / /⑤dper na sred pa rnam par dpyad ④ pa dag la zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na'o/ /dge slong dag dra ba dang 'khri shing dang /mtsho dang / rab tu 'bags pa dang gang dang gang gis ④skye dgu la sgrib pa/rab tu sgrib pa/ khyab par byed pa/ rab tu khyab par byed pa/ bkab pa dang / g.yogs pa dang / rab tu 'gebs pa dang / dru bu 'dzings pa lta bu dang 3༄/ rtswa mun dza dang bal ba kyedza lta bu dang / 'gro ba dang 'ong bar gyur cing 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol du lce nying mtshams spyor bar byed pa/'khor bar 'khor zhing 'jug par byed pa bsten mapar bya ste/ dge slong dag srid pa'i dra ba dang / 'khri shing dang / mtsho dang / rab tu 'bab pa dang 1 gang dang gang dag ( gis skye dgu la sgrib par 1༷ byed pa nas nying mtshams sbyor bar byed pa 8'khor bar 'khor zhing 'jug par byed pa'i bar du byed pa de gang zhe na/ dge slong dag de'o zhes bya ba byung bar gyur cing / nga 'di lta bu'o zhes bya ba byung bar gyur cing / nga 'di 'dra'o snyam du byung bar gyur cing /nga de lta ma yin no snyam du byung bar gyur cing / nga bzang ngo snyam du byung bar gyur cing / nga ngan no snyam du byung bar gyur cing / 'gyur bar bya'o snyam pa dang / 'gyur bar mi bya'o snyam pa dang / 'di lta bur 'gyur bar bya'o/ /'di 'dra bar 'gyur bar bya'o/ /de lta ma yin par 'gyur bar bya'o snyam pa dang /82—228

'di lta bur gyur cig snyam pa dang / 'di 'dra bar gyur cig snyam pa dang /de lta ma yin par gyur cig nyusnyam pa dang / gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pa dang /'di lta bur gyur kyang ci ⑤ma rung snyam pa dang / 'di 'dra bar gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pa dang / de lta ma yin par gyur kyang ci ma rung zhes dge slong dag nang gi bdag nyid la brten te/ sred pa spyod pa bco brgyad 'byung bar 'gyur ro / /dge slong dag de la bdag go snyam pa byung bar gyur cing / bdag 'di lta bu'o snyam pa byung zhing / bdag 'di 'dra'o snyam pa byung zhing / bdag bzang ngo zhe snyam pa byung bar gyur cing / bdag ngan no snyam pa byung bar gyur la/'gyur bar bya'o snyam pa byung zhing / 'gyur bar mi bya'o snyam pa dang / 'di lta bur 'gyur bar bya snyam pa dang / 'di 'dra bar dze+e'agyur bar bya snyam pa dang /de lta ma yin par 'gyur bar bya'o snyam pa dang / gyur cig snyam pa dang /'di lta bur gyur cig snyam pa dang / 'di 'dra bar snyegyur cig snyam pa dang /de lta ma yin par gyur cig snyam pa dang / gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pa dang /'di lta bur gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pa dang / 'di 'dra bar gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pa dang / de lta ma yin par gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pa zhes dge slong dag phyi'i bdag nyid la brten nas sred pa spyod pa bco brgyad po 'di dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag stso gcig tu bsdus na sred pa spyod pa sum cu rtsa drug 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag 'das pa'i dus la brten nas sred pa spyod pa sum cu rtsa drug byung la/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus la brten nas sred pa spyod pa dze+esum cu rtsa drug 'byung zhing / da ltar byung ba'i dus la brten nas sred pa spyod pa sum cu rtsa drug byung ste/ gcig tu bsdus na/ sred pa spyod pa brgya rtsa 82—229

brgyad 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag 'di ni sred pa'i dra ba dang /'khri shing dang / mtsho dang / rab tu 'bags pa dang / gang dang gang gis skye dgu 'di la sgrib pa dang rab tu sgrib pa zhes bya ba nas/ 'khor bar 'khor ba sgrub par byed pa zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /dge slong dag sred pa'i dra ba dang /'khri shing dang / mtsho nyudang / rab tu 'bags pa gang dang gang gis skye dgu 'di la sgrib pa dang rab tu sgrib pa/ khyab par byed pa/ rab tu khyab par byed pa/ bkab pa dang / g.yogs pa dang / rab tu 'gebs pa dang /dru bu 'dze+engs pa lta bu/ rtswa mun dza dang bal ba 3dza lta bu dang / 'gro ba dang 'ongs par zhegyur pa 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol du nying mtshams sbyor bar byed cing 'khor bar 'khor bar byed pa bsten pyapar bya'o zhes ji skad du bstan pa de rgyas par rab tu bshad do zhes bka' sprul to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis chos gang dag 'dus byas kyang rung 'dus ma byas kyang rung ba de dag gi mchog ni 'dod chags dang bral ba yin par bshad do zhes bya ba la/ gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na'o/ /dge slong dag btags pa'i mchog ni rnam pa gsum ste/ gsum gang zhe na/ btags pa'i mchog sangs rgyas dang / btags pa'i mchog chos dang dge 'dun no/ /btags pa'i mchog sangs rgyas gang zhe na/ sems can gang rkang pa med pa dang / rkang gnyis pa'am/ rkang mangs samathu/ gzugs can nam/ gzugs can ma yin pa'am/ 'du shes can nam 'du shes med pa'amagye/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched gang ci yang rung ba de dag gi nang na 3bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni 82—230

mchog ces brjod do zhes bya'o/ /gang cung zad sangs rgyas la mngon par dad pas lha'i nang na lhar gyur pa mi'i nang na mir gyur pa de dag ni 'di ltar lkurnam par smin pa'i mchog la re bar 'ubya'o/ /'di ni btags 1pa'i mchog sangs rgyas zhes bya'o/ /btags pa'i mchog chos gang zhe na/ 'dus byas kyang rung 'dus ma byas kyang rung chos gang ci yang rung ba de dag gi nang /④na mchog ni 'dod chags dang bral ba yin par bshad de/ gang cung zad chos la mngon par dad pas mngon par dad pa/ lha'i nang na lhar gyur pa/ mi'i chonang na mir gyur pa de dag ni 'di ltar rnam par smin pa'i mchog la re bar bya ste/'di ni skubatags pa'i mchog chos zhes bya'o/ /btags pa'i mchog dge 'dun gang zhe na/ 'dus pa'am tshogs pa'am ma 3tshogs pa'am 'khor gang ci yang rung ba rnams kyi nang na mchog ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun yin par bshad de/ gang cung zad chos dang dge 'dun la mngon par dad pas mngon par dad pa/ lha'i nang na lhar gyur pa/ mi'i nang na mir gyur pa de dag ni 'di ltar rnam par smin pa'i mchog la re bar bya ste3/ 'di ni btags pa'i mchog dge 'dun zhes bya'o zhes gsungs nas ston pas gzhan yang 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /chos mchog rnam par shes nas ni/ /yon gnas tsubhe bla na med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas mchog la rab dang ba/ /'jig rten mchog la rab tu dang / /nyer zhi 'dod chags dang bral ba'i/ /chos mchog la ni rab dad dang / /bsod nams zhing mchog bla med pa'i/ /dge 'dun mchog la rab dad cing / /mchog gi sbyin pa rab byed pa⑫/ /bsod nams mchog ni rab tu 'dzin/ /tshe dang kha dog mchog dang ni/ /grags dang stobs 82—231

dang bde ba dang / /mal stan mchog dag thob gyur cing 7/ /longs spyod spyod pa nyid du 'gyur/ /gnas mchog la ni gnas pa dang / /mdzes pa'i mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /sbyin pa mchog la sbyin pa dang / /chos kyi mchog dang ldan pa dang / /shes rab phun sum tshogs byas nas/ /mya ngan 'das par 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes bka' sprul to / / zumado las mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa'i dge slong zhes bya ba la/ gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na'o/ /de nas dge slong gzhan zhig nang du yang dag 'jog nga las langs nas bcom ldan 'das gang na 5ba der nye bar song ste/ nye bar song nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 3zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa dge slong mthong ba'i chos la ⑥mya ngan las 'das pa ⑦thob pa dge slong mthong ba'i chos la rkyemya ngan las 'das pa thob pa zhes bya ba la ⑨/btsun pa ji tsam gyis na mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa'i dge slong du 'gyuratso/ ji tsam gyis na bde bar gshegs pas mthong ba'i chos la skyemya ngan las 'das pa thob pa'i dge slong zhes tha snyad gdags pas btags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong de la 'di skad ces bka' sprul to/ /dge slong legs so legs so/ /dge slong khyod 'di lta bu'i dri ba 'dri ba mthong ba'i chos la hu)mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa zhes bya ba nas snga ma bzhin du tha snyad btags so 3zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /dge slong khyod 'di lta bu 'dri'am/ btsun pa de bzhin no/ /de'i phyir dge slong legs par nyon 82—232

la yid la zung shig 1dang bshad par bya'o/ /dge slong gzugs la skyo ba dang 'dod chags dang bral ba dang 'gog pa dang nye bar len pa med par zag pa dag tsalas sems rnam par grol zhing gnas na mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa'i dge slong zhes brjod par nus so/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa la skyo ba dang 'dod chags dang bral ba dang /'gog pa dang / nye bar len pa dag las sems rnam par grol zhing gnas na mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa'i dge slong zhes brjod par nus to③ / /dge slong 'di tsam gyis na mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa'i dge slong zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong 'di tsam gyis na bde bar gshegs pas mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa'i dge slong zhes tha snyad btags so/ /de nas dge slong de bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga' zhing rjes su yi rangs byenas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs drung nas song ngo / /'di skad du sdug bsngal 'di ni phyam lus par spangs pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na'o/ /de nas dge slong gzhan zhig gcig pu dbe+en pa na nang du yang dag 'jog la gnas pa na sems la yongs su rtog pa/ kyeji ltar shes shing thuji ltar mthong na chos mthong bar 'gyur zhes 'di lta bu skyes so/ /de nas dge slong de nang du yang dag 'jog las langs nas/bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste/ nye bar song nas zhes bya ba 3nas/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /btsun pa bdag 'di na gcig pu dbe+en pa na nang du yang dag 'jog la gnas pa na sems 82—233

la yongs su rtog pa/ ji ltar shes shing ji ltar mthong na chos mthong bar khye'agyur zhes 'di lta bu skyes so/ /dge slong de'i phyir legs par nyon la yid la zung shig spyodang gnyis shig bshad par bya'o/ /gnyis gang zhe na/ mig dang / gzugs dang / rna ba dang / sgra nasathu/ yid dang chos kyi bar du sterka/ 'di ni gnyis zhes bya'o/ /dge slong gang kha cig 'di skad du/ dge spyong pyago ta ma btags pa 'di ni gnyis ma yin gyis/ bdag gi cho 'di ltar gnyis po de las bzlog pa gzhan gnyis gdags par bya'o zhes smra ba 'di ni tshig tsam dang / dris pa'i lan yang dag par mi shes shing mgo rmongs par byed pa ste/'di ltar de'i yul ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge slong mig dang gzugs la brten nas skyes pa mig gi rnam par shes pa dang / gsum 'dus pa'i reg pa dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang sems pa zhes bya ba 'di ni dge slong bdag gi gzugs can ma yin pa'i phung po bzhi dang / gzugs can mig gi dbang po ste/ 'di tsam la mi zhes bya'o/ /de la sems can dang mi dang shed las skyes dang shed bu dang gang zag dang srog dang gso ba zhes 'dogs so/ /dge slong de la bdag gi mig gis gzugs rnams mthong ngo zhes bya ba nasaskye/ yid kyis chos rnams rnam par shes so zhes bya ba'i bar du nye bar 'dogs so/ /de la 'di dag kyang tha snyad de tshe dang ldan pa'i ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di lta bu/ rigs ni 'di lta bu/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal ni 'di lta bu zhig myong / tshe ring zhing yun ring po 'di tsam zhig tu gnas/ che'i mtha' ni 'di tsam zhig tu gyur zhes dz+wabya ba 'di ni dge slong gang dā'adu shes tsam 'di ni dam bcas pa tsam mo/ /ji ltar 'di thams 82—234

cad tha snyad ②tsam yin zhe na/ dge slong chos 'di dag thams cad rgo mi rtag pa dang mngon par 'dus byas pa dang / sems las byung ba dang / brten te skyes pa'o/ /gang mi rtag pa/ mngon par 'dus byas pa sems las byung ba brten te 3/skyes pa de dag ni sdug bsngal ba/ de ni sdug bsngal skye ba rngu/ sdug bsngal gnas pa dang / mngon par 'phel ba dang / gang sdug bsngal yang dang yang du rab tu 'byung ba'o/ /gang sdug bsngal 'di ma lus par spangs pa/byang bar gyur pa/ zad pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba/ 'gog pa/ rnam par zhi ba/ nub pa/ sdug bsngal gzhan dang nying mtshams spyor ba med pa/len pa med pa 'byung ba med pa gang yin pa 'di lta thu ste/ phung po thams cad nges par spangs pa/ srid pa zad pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba/ 'gog pa/mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ dge slong gang 'ga' zhig chos 'di rnams la sems shing 'jal ba dang gnas pa 'di ni phyis yid la yongs su gdung ba mi 'jug cing len pa med pa zhes bya'o/ /dge slong ci ste gang bdag gis bdag 'di ltar shes shing 'di ltar mthong ba de chos mngon par 'gyur ro/ /rna ba dang / sna dang /lce dang / lus dang reg bya la brten nas skyes pa lus kyi rnam par shes pa dang /gsum 'dus pa'i reg pa dang lhan cig skyes pa'i tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /sems pa 3zhes bya ba 'di ni bdag gi gzugs can ma yin pa'i phung po bzhi dang /gzugs can lus kyi dbang po ste 'di tsam la mi zhes bya'o/ /de la sems can dang mi dang shed phyalas skyes pa dang shed bu dang skyes bu dang gang zag dang srog dang gso ba zhes tha snyad 'dogs so/ /dge slong /3de la bdag gi mig gis gzugs rnams mthong ngo zhes bya ba nas/ yid kyis chos rnams rnam par shes 82—235

so zhes bya ba'i bar du tha snyad 'dogs te/ de la 'di dag kyang tha snyad de ①tshe dang ldan pa lceming 'di zhes bya ba nas/ dge slong gang 'di ltar shes shing 'di ltar mthong ba de chos mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /dge slong yid dang chos la brten nas skyes pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang / gsum 'dus pa'i reg pa dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /sems pa zhes bya ba 'di ni dge slong bdag gi gzugs can ma yin pa'i phung po bzhi yin la/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i lus te 'di tsam la mi zhes bya'o④// /de la sems can dang mi dang shed las skyes pa dang shed bu dang skyes bu dang gang zag dang srog dang gso ba zhes 'dogs so/ /dge slong de la bdag gi mig gis gzugs rnams mthong ngo zhes bya ba nas/ yid kyis chos rnams rnam par shes so zhes bya ba'i bar du nye bar 'dogs so/ /de la 'di dag kyang tha snyad de thu/tshe dang ldan pa phye ming ni 'di zhes bya ba nas/ dge slong gang 'di ltar shes shing 'di ltar mthong ba des 'uchos mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ bde bar gshegs pas de skad gsungs nas/ ston pas gzhan yang 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /ming 3dang gzugs dag gnyis la brten nas ni/ /skyes par gyur pa sems las byung ba'i chos/ /rnam shes reg dang lhan cig tshor ba dang / /'du shes sems pa 'udang ni rgyu dang bcas/ /gang zag shed las skyes dang shed bu dang / /'di na bdag gam bdag gi sgo/ bya ba med/ /phung po sdug bsngal yongs su 'gyur ba'i chos/ /skye ba'i chos can 'jig pa'i chos can yin/ /sems can ming ke dang shed skyes shed bu ste/ /'di dag yod ces 'dir ni btags pa yin/ /82—236

phung po ①rgyu mtshan rgyu las de dag las/ /gzhan yang rnam mang 'du shes skye b.ra'agyur—/ /ci ste dge sbyong grubram ze gzhan gang dag /bdag cag gnyis las gzhan gnyis 'chad smras pa/ /tshig gis zumangon par brjod pa'i skal ba can—/ /'dri ba'i lan dag rab tu mi shes yin/ /las dang sred pa dang ni ma rig pa/ /phyi ④ma'i tshe la 'du byed rnams kyi rgyu/ /phung po dag las phung po yang gzhan thudu/ /nying mtshams sbyor ba gang zag ces smra'o/ /srid zhepa ma lus nye bar zhi ba dang / /ma rig 3nub cing rab tu 'gags phyapa na/ /sred pa zad pas sdug bsngal rab zad par/ /'di ltar spyan dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas gsung rngu/ /zhes bka' pa pa to / //— mar me shi bar gyur pa ltar/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo dang / dbyangs kyi tshogs kyi mdo las tshangs pa'i sgo'i mdor spe7'don pa lta bu ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das ma thag 11pa nyid du tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pas tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ dbugs rngub pa dang dbugs 'byung byunadang / /sems brtan par ni skyob pa gnas/ /mi g.yo zhi ba rtogs nas ni/ /srun ldan yongs su mya ngan 'das/ /gang tshe rnam kun stobs lnga pa/ /ston pa dus mdzad gyur pa na/ /de tshe 'jigs pa'i sgra 5byung zhing / /ba spu ldang ba byung bar gyur/ /zhum pa med pa'i sems kyis na/ /tshor ba yongs su bzod mdzad cing / /mar me shi bar gyur pa ltar/ /de yi sems ni murnam par thar/ /lam gyi tshogs las kyang bslab pa'i sgo'i mdo 'di ltar tshigs su bcad pa 'don te / de dag srog dang bral gyur cing / /rnam par sred zad rnam par grol/ /82—237

mar me shi bar gyur pa ltar/ / de yi sems ni kyernam par thar/ /zhes mdzod kyi ༄1gnas brgyad pa tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin zhes mdo 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /mdo las rkyen nyid ni bzhi ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ bzhi las 'phros pa'i mdo las/ rab tu rig dang rkyen dang ni/ /zhes ④bya bar gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na'o zhes 'don pa lta bu'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang bsam gtan rnams kyi yul ni bsam gyis mi khyab po zhes gsungs so zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ gleng gzhi rgo mnyan du yod pa na'o/ /bzhi po 'di ni bsam 5gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas te/ bsam par byed na smyo bar 'gyur zhing mgo rmongs pa dang sems g.yengs pa thob par 'gyur ro / /bzhi gang zhe na/ bdag bsam pa dang / 'jig rten bsam pa dang /sems can kyi las kyi rnam par smin pa dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi yul lo zhes bka' sal to / /6mi sdug pa dang lhan cig pa'i dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ces bya ba la sogs pa la/ gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na'o/ /dge slong dag mi sdug pa sgom par byed cing kun du bsten 8cing lan mang du byas na 'bras bu chen por 'gyur zhing bsngags pa che bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar 'bras bu che sheb dang bsngags pa che ba'i mi ⑩sdug pa bsgom par 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong 'di la mi sngug pa dang lhan cig pa'i dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dbe+en pa la gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa / 1 rnam par spong bas yongs su sgyur ba 1 sgom par byed de/ dge slong 82—238

'di la mi sdug pa dang lhan cig par gyur pa'i chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa dang / dga' ba dang shin tu sbyangs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dben pa la gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas yongs su sgyur nyub sgom par byed de/ dge slong 'di lta bu na'abras bu che ba dang bsngags pa che ba'i mi sdug pa sgom byepar 'gyur ro zhes bka' pal to/ /chos mngon pa ④mdzod kyi mdo dang sbyar ba'i ṭī ka 5nye bar mkho ba zhes bya ba las gnas gnyis pa phal cher mdo dang sbyar ba'o // //6'jig rten sna tshogs gang de 'dod pa min/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa la / gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na'o/ /de nas hūṃtshe dang ldan pa 'dod pa can bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der nye bar song ste/ nye bar song nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa'i bar du'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'dod pa can bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa 'dod pa 'dod pa zhes bgye ba 'di lta ste/ 'dod pa 'dod pa zhes bgyi ba de 8gang gi tshig bla dwags lags/ bka' stsal pa ge/ 'dod pa 'dod pa zhes bya ba 'di ni 1 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i tshig bla dwags ma yin gyi/ 'on kyang 'dun pa'i 'dod chags 'di la 'dod rngu pa zhes bya'o/ /'jig rten sna tshogs gang de 'dod pa min/ /skyes bu'i kun rtog 'dod chags 'dod pa yin/ /'jig rten dag na sna tshogs de bzhin gnas/ /'on kyang brtan rnams 'di nyu2 la 'dun pa 'dul/ /btsun pa 'on kyang lam rtogs shing bstan / ༄pa dang / bsgoms mupa dang / lan mang du byas na me'adun 82—239

pa dang 'dod chags spong bar khye'agyur ba yod dam/ 'dod pa can yod de/'di lta ste/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yang dag pa'i lta ba nas/yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin kyi bar du'o/ /btsun pa rab tu rtogs pa dang /bsten 2/pa dang / bsgoms byepa dang / lan mang du byas na 'dod pa spong ba'i lam 'di ni bzang ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'dod pa can bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga' zhing rjes su yi rang nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas te zhabs drung nas song ngo / /'dod pa ni 'dod chags zhes rtogs par nus kyang chos mngon pa'i bstan bcos de dang de las 'dod pa'i 'dod chags nyid du rtogs par bya ba'i phyir kun du rgyu 'tsho byed la 'phags pa shā ri'i bus ji skad du tshigs su bcad pa gnyis 'thad pa dang bcas pa bkod pa slob dpon gyis bris pa bzhin du chobalta bar bya'o/ /mdo las dper na char gyi rgyun gnya' shing tsam 'bab pa phyen zhes bya ba la/bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can kyi spre'u dze+eng gi 'gram khu gyi gtsug lag khang na bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bos te/dge slong dag sems can ma rig pas bsgribs shing dz+wasred pas kun du spyor zhing sred pas gtums shing yun ring por 'khor bar mtshams sbyor zhing sdug bsngal gyi sngon gyi mtha' mi shes pa rnams kyi 'khor ba thog ma dang tha ma med de/ dper na char gyi rgyun gnya' shing tsam 'bab pa na bar snang la chu'i rgyun 'bab pa rnams kyi bar mtshams med de/ de bzhin du shar gyi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams chags pa dang / 'jig rwa—pa dang / gzhan zhig nas 'dug pa dang /gzhan chags pa dang / gzhan chags nas gnas pa rnams kyi bar dang mtshams 82—240

med dekhye/ de bzhin du lho dang / nub dang / byang 3phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'jig pa dang chags pa dang / gzhan 'jig ba dang / gzhan zhig nas 3'dug pa dang / gzhan chags pa dang / gzhan chags nas gnas pa rnams kyi bar dang mtshams med do/ /dge slong dag sems can ma rig 3pas bsgribs shing sred pas kun du spyor zhing tresred pas gtums te/ yun ring por 'khor bar mtshams sbyor ba ni sdug bsngal gyi mtha' mi shes pa rnams kyi 'khor ba thog ma dang tha ma med do/ /dge slong dag de'i phyir 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/gang las sred hūṃpa chad pa dang gang rtogs pas sred pa mngon par mi grub pa de ltar dge slong dag khyed kyis bslab par bya'o / /8 'o na tshe dang ldan pa byechos de dag las ma gtogs pa'i dmyal ba ma dmigs so zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ 'di skad du kha che ba mdo 'don gyiṅku/nyi 'og pa rnams ni ma yin pas 'di ni ma rnyed do/ /yang snyigs ma rnam pa lnga mdo de dang de las 'don pa lta bu ste/ re zhig ji ltar yang dag par ldan pa'i las de'i mdo las btsun pa rgyu gang dang rkyen gang gis bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon ni bslab pa'i gzhi 13 ches nyung ngu dag bcas kyang dge slong rab tu mang po dag dgra bcom pa nyid thob cing gnas la bcom ldan 'das kyis da ltar ni bslab pa'i gzhi ches mang po bcas kyang dge slong ches nyung ngu dag dgra bcom pa thob cing gnas par gyur/ dga' byed de bzhin no/ /ji ltar da ltar tshe'i snyigs ma dang / nyon mongs pa'i snyigs ma dang / dus kyi snyigs ma dang /lta ba'i snyigs ma dang / sems can gyi snyigs ma dag gis dga' byed sems can rnams nyams par byas shing dam pa'i chos kyang nub pa'i dus na ston pas nyan 82—241

thos kyi 1'dul ba'i bslab pa'i gzhi ches mang po bcas kyang dge slong ches nyung ngu dag dgra bcom pa nyid thob cing gnas par 'gyur ro zhes 'byung ngo / /rnam shes gnas pa bdun zhes bya ba la/ bdun las 'phros pa'i bdun pa'i sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa brgyad cu pa la sogs pa la lta 2bar bya'o/ /'di nyid du yang mdzod kyi gnas dang por/ de las gzhan yang ci rigs par / /zhes bya ba'i skabs su skye mched gnyis po zhes bya ba 'grel par bris zin pa dang / sems can gyi gnas 'chad par 'gyur ba las ming gzhan du byas pa rtogs par bya'o / / 1mdo las sems can de dag 'di snyam du zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni mdzod kyi gnas gsum pa 'di nyid du rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i skabs su tshangs pa'i dra ba las lta ba drug cu rtsa gnyis bshad pa/ ji skad du tshangs pa'i dra ba las zhes bya ba 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de la sngon gyi mtha' la rnam par rtog cepa rnams kyi dang po'i gzhi las 'di skad du 'don te/ dge slong dag 'jig rten 'jig par 'gyur ba'i dus yod de5/ 'jig rten 'di 6'jig par gyur pa na sems can phal cher 'od gsal gyi lha'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur te/ yid las byung ba'i gzugs can dbang po ma tshangs pa 7med pa/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa/ kha dog dang dbyibs mdzes pa/ rang gi 'od can nam mkha' la thogs pa med par 'gro ba/ dga' ba za zhing dga' ba'i zas dang ldan pa tshe ring zhing dus ring por gnas par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag 'jig rten 'di 'chags par 'gyur ba'i dus yod de/ 'jig rten 'di 'chags pa na nam mkha' stong pa la —tshangs pa'i gzhal med khang mngon par 82—242

'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas sems can gzhan gang yang rung ba zhig tshe zad las zad bsod nams zad pas 'od gsal gyi lha'i ris nas shi 'phos tehūṃ/tshangs pa'i gzhal med khang stong pa'i nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de de na gabyug pu zla med cing grogs med par gyur pa 3yun ring zhing dus ring po zhig tu gnas te / de nas sems can de dus ring por gnas pa na kye ma bdag dang skal ba mnyam pa'i sems can gzhan dag kyang 'dir skyes na ci ma rung zhes sred pa skye zhing snamangon par dga' ba yang dag par skyes so/ /sems can de de ltar sems la smon cing gnas pa na sems can de dang skal ba mnyam pa sems can gzhan zhig tshe zad cing las zad pa bsod nams zad pas 'od gsal gyi lha'i ris de genas shi 'phos nas tshangs pa'i gzhal med khang du skyes par gyur to/ /de nas sems can de 'di snyam du sems par 'gyur zhete/ bdag gcig spyopu zla med cing grogs med par chetshe ring zhing yun ring bar gnas te/ kye ma bdag dang skal ba mnyam pa'i sems/ can gzhan dag kyang 'dir skyes na ci ma rung zhes dus ring por sred pa skyes shing dga' ba yang dag par skyes shing tsubadag gi sems la de ltar smon pas bdag dang skal ba mnyam pa'i sems can 'dir skyes la sems can 'di dag ni bdag gis sprul pa/ bdag ni sems can 'di dag gi dbang phyug /byed pa po/ sprul pa po/ rab tu 'byin pa po/ dngos po rnams kyi pha lta bur gyur pa'onyu / /sems can de dag kyang 'di snyam du sems can 'di gcig pu zla med cing grogs med par gyur pa tshe ring zhing yun ring por gnas pa sems can de tshe ring zhing yun ring por gnas te/ kye ma bdag dang skal ba mnyam pa'i sems can gzhan dag kyang 'dir skyes na ci ma rung zhes sred 82—243

pa skyes shing yang dag par dga' ba skyes pa hūṃsems can de'i sems la 'di ltar smon pas sems can de dang skal ba mnyam par 3bdag cag kyang 'dir skyes shing sems can 'di ni bdag cag gi sprul pa po/ sems can 'di ni bdag cag gi dbang phyug /byed pa po/ 'byin pa po/ rab tu 'byin par byed pa/dngos po rnams kyi pha lta bur gyur pa'o zhes 'byung ngo / /'od gsal gyi lha'i ris de na sems can gang dag ces bya ba la sogs pa la/bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can spre'u'i rdzing gi 'gram gyi gtsug lag khang 1na bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bos te/dge slong dag 'du byed thams cad ni mi rtag pa mi brtan pa④/ yid brtan par bya ba ma yin pa yongs su 'gyur ba'i chos can yin pas spong snyebar bya'o/ /dge slong dag 'dus byas thams cad la yongs su 5skyo bar bya'o/ /'dod chags dang bral bar bya'o/ /rnam par grol bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag 'di lta bur 'gyur ba'i dus yod de dus ring por gyur pa na lha rnams kyis tsuchar gyi rgyun mi 'bebs par 'gyur te/ lha rnams kyi char gyi rgyun ma phab pas sa chen po'i sa bon gyi tshogs dang / 'byung po'i tshogs dang / sman dang rtswa dang nags tshal thams cad skams byepar 'gyur zhing mi 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag 'dus byas 'di dag ni mi rtag pa mi brtan pa yid brtan par bya ba ma yin pa yongs su 'gyur ba'i chos can yin pas yongs su spong 1bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag 'dus byas thams cad la skyo bar bya'o/ /'dod chags dang bral bar bya'o⑫//rnam par grol bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag gang las dus ring por gyur pa na nyi ma gnyis 'char ba'i dus yod de/ 'jig rten du nyi ma gnyis shar ba na sa chen 82—244

po 'di lngongam grog chung ngu dang / ngam grog chen po thams cad skams byepar 'gyur zhing 'umi 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag 'dus byas thams cad ni 'di ltar mi rtag pa mi brtan pa/ yid brtan par bya ba sdem yin pa yongs su gyur pa'i 7chos can yin pas yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag 'dus byas thams cad las hūṃyongs su skyo bar bya'o/ /'dod chags dang bral bar bya'o/ /rnam par grol bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag gang las dus ring por gyur pa na 'jig rten 'dir nyi ma gsum 'char bar 'gyur ba'i dus de yod de/dge slong dag 'jig rten na nyi ma gsum 'char ba na sa chen po 'di'i chu klung chung ngu 3dang chu klung chen po thams cad skams shing mi 'byung bar 'gyur te/dge slong dag 'dus byas 'di dag ni 'di ltar mi rtag pa byemi brtan pa/ yid brtan par 1bya ba ma yin pa yongs su 'gyur ba'i chos can yin pas yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag 'dus byas thams cad las khye yongs su skyo bar bya'o / /'dod chags dang bral bar bya'o/ /rnam par grol bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag gang las dus ring por gyur pa na/ 'jig rten 'dir nyi ma bzhi 'char ba'i dus yod de/ dge slong dag 'jig rten 'dir nyi ma bzhi 'char ba na mtsho chung ngu dang gang mtsho chen po ma dros pa zhes bya ba dang / chu klung chen po 'di lta ste/ gang gā dang / sen+tu dang / si ta dang / pak+ṣu zhes bya ba de dag kyang de'i tshe skams par 'gyur zhing mi 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag 'dus byas thams cad ni 2mi rtag pa mi brtan pa/ yid brtan par bya ba ma yin pa/ yongs su 'gyur ba'i chos can yin pas yongs su spang bar skyebya'o/ /dge slong dag 'dus byas thams cad la yongs su skyo bar bya'o/ /'dod chags 82—245

dang bral bar bya'o/ /rnam par grol bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag dus ring por gyur pa na 'jig rten 'dir nyi ma lnga 'char bar 'gyur ba'i dus yod de/'jig rten 'dir nyi ma lnga shar ba na rgya 2mtsho chen bo las chu dpag tshad brgya phrag gcig skams par 'gyur zhing nyams pa dang mi 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dpag tshad brgya phrag gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga dang / drug dang / bdun gyi chu skams shing nyams pa dang mi 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag nyi ma lnga pa 'jig rten 'dir shar ba na/ rgya mtsho chen po las chu dpag tshad stong phrag gcig skams par 'gyur zhing nyams pa dang mi 'byung bar 'gyur zhing dpag tshad stong phrag gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi dang /lnga dang / drug dang / bdun gye chu bskams 3shing nyams pa dang mi 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag nyi ma lnga pa 'jig rten 'dir shar ba na rgya mtsho chen po las dpag tshad stong phrag bdun gyi chu las par 'gyur zhing / dpag tshad stong phrag drug dang lnga dang bzhi dang gsum dang gnyis dang gcig gi chu las par 'gyur te/ dge slong dag nyi ma lnga 'jig rten 'di na 4shar ba na rgya mtsho chen po las dpag tshad bdun gyi chu las par 'gyur zhing drug dang lnga dang bzhi dang gsum dang dpag tshad 5gnyis dang gcig gi chu las par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag nyi ma lnga pa 'jig rten 'dir shar ba na rgya mtsho chen po bdun 6las rgyang grags bdun gyi chu las par 'gyur zhing drug dang lnga dang bzhi dang gsum dang gnyis dang rgyang grags gcig gi chu las par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag nyi ma lnga pa 'jig rten 'dir shar ba na rgya mtsho chen po la ta dzol bdun tsam gyi chu las par 'gyur zhing drug dang lnga dang bzhi dang gsum dang gnyis dang ta phyal 82byed246

gasbug tsam gyi chu las par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag nyi ma lnga pa 'jig rten 'dir shar ba na rgya mtsho chen po las mi 'greng bdun tsam gyi chu las par 'gyur zhing / drug dang lnga dang bzhi dang gsum dang gnyis dang mi 'greng gcig tsam gyi chu las par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag nyi ma lnga 7'jig rten 'dir shushar ba na rgya mtsho chen po las 'gul ba ༄ tsam gyi chu las par 'gyur zhing mchan khung tsam dang lte ba tsam dang / dbyi 4zur tsam dang / brla tsam dang / rje ngar tsam dang / long bu nub pa tsam gye chu las par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag nyi ma lnga pa 'jig rten 'dir shar ba na rgya mtsho chen po'i chu thams cad kyi thams cad du bskams phyashing nyams pa dang mi 'byung bar 'gyur te/ sor mo'i rtse mo nub pa tsam du 'gyur te/ dge slong dag 'dus byas thams cad ni 'di ltar mi rtag pa 6mi brtan pa/ yid brtan par bya ba ma yin pa/ yongs su 'gyur ba'i chos can yin pas yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag 'dus byas thams cad las dzayongs su skyo bar bya'o/ /'dod chags dang bral bar bya'o/ /rnam par grol bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag gang las dus ring por gyur pa na 'jig rten 'dir nyi ma drug 'char bar 'gyur ba'i dus yod de/ dge slong dag nyi ma drug shar ba na sa chen po 'di dang ri'i rgyal po ri rab las du ba 'byung bar 'gyur zhing / du ba rab tu 'thul ba dang / rab tu du ba 'thul bar 'gyur te/'di lta ste rdza mkhan kyi bsreg khang la dang po me sbar bsani/ dang po du ba 'byung bar 'gyur zhing / du ba rab tu 'thul ba dang / du ba kun du 'thul bar 'gyur ba tshode bzhin du dge slong dag nyi ma drug po 'jig rten 'dir shar ba na sa chen po 'di ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang bcas pa la du ba 'byung bar 'gyur 82—247

zhing / du ba rab tu 'thul ba dang / du ba kun du 'thul bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag 'dus byas thams cad ni hūṃmi rtag pa/ mi brtan pa/ yid brtan par bya ba ma yin pa/ yongs su 'gyur ba'i chos can yin pas yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag 'dus byas thams cad la yongs su skyo bar bya'o//'dod chags dang bral bar bya'o/ /rnam par grol bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag gang las dus ring por gyur pa na 'jig rten 'dir nyi ma bdun 'char bar 'gyur ba'i dus yod de/ dge slong dag 'jig rten 'dir nyi ma bdun shar ba na sa chen po 'di ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang bcas pa 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar te kun du 'bar zhing me lce gcig tu gyur cing sreg par byed do/ /'di lta ste shing gi khur po 2bcu dang / nyi shu dang / sum cu dang / bzhi bcu dang / lnga bcu dang / shing khur brgya dang / shing gi khur po 4brgya stong phrag du ma dang /shing gi khur po ༷gzhan brgya stong 6phrag du ma dang / shing gi khur bo 3stong phrag du ma dang / shing gi khur po snagazhan brgya stong phrag du ma las byung ba'i gre'i phung po chen po sreg par byed pa de bzhin du dge slong dag 'jig rten 'dir nyi ma bdun shar ba na sa chen po ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang bcas pa 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar te kun du 'bar zhing 9me lce gcig tu gyur cing sreg par byed do/ /dge slong dag sa chen po ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang bcas pa 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar te/ kun tu 'bar zhing me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg pa'i ste mo rlung gis g.yengs pas tshangs pa'i gzhal med khang stong pa sreg par byed do/ /dge slong dag 'od gsal gyi lha'i ris de na sems can gang dag byes nas ring du ma lon pa 'jig rten 'di 1 'jig pa la mi mkhas shing 'chags nyu pa la mi mkhas pa de 82—248

dag me lce de mthong nas me lces tshangs pa'i gzhal med khang stong pa bsreg tshopa 'dir 'ongs par gyur na mi rung ngo zhes skrag nas yi 37chad byung skyo bar 'gyur ro//dge slong dag ③'od gsal gyi lha'i ris de na sems can thudag skyes nas ring du lon pa 'jig rten 'jig pa la mkhas shing 'chags pa la mkhas pa de dag sems can skrag pa de dag la grogs po dag ma 'jigs shig /grogs po dag ma 'jigs shig /me lce 'di sngon yang tshangs pa'i gzhal med khang stong pa bsregs nas de nyid du rnged par gyur to zhes dbugs 'byin par byed do/ /dge slong dag ri'i rgyal po ri rab 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar te kun du 'bar zhing me lce gcig tu gyur cing bsregs phyepa na dpag tshad stong phrag gcig gi tregazhal med khang tshig cing nyams pa dang mi 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi dang lnga dang drug dang dpag tshad stong phrag bdun gyi gzhal med khang tshig cing nyams pa dang mi 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag sa chen po dang ri'i rgyal po ri rab tshig cing bsregs pa na thal ba tsam gyi 7lhag ma yang ma srelus par 'gyur ro/ /dper na mar ram til bsregs 9tshig pa dag 1 rjes tsam yang dri nyu1ma tsam yang ma lus par 'gyur ba de bzhin du/ dge slong dag sa chen po dang ri'i rgyal po ri rab tshig cing bsregs pa na rjes tsam gyi'am grib ma tsam gyi (/ma lus par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de la rgya mtsho chen po bskams — par 'gyur zhing / nyams pa dang mi 'byung bar 'gyur zhes bya ba la mngon du mthong ba ma ⑫gtogs par su zhig dad cing shāstseyid ches par 'gyur/ dge slong dag de la gang yang ri'i rgyal po ri rab tshig cing rab tu tshig pa dang nyams pa dang mi 'byung bar 'gyur 82—249

zhes bya ba la mngon du mthong ba ma gtogs par hūṃsu zhig dad cing yid ches par 'gyur / dge slong dag de 3la sa chen po tshig cing rab tu tshig pa dang nyams pa dang mi 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba la mngon du mthong ba ma gtogs pa su zhig dad cing yid ches par 'gyur/ dge slong dag sngon byung ba ston pa mig bzangs byezhes bya ba phyi rol mu stegs pa rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa 'dod pa las 'dod chags dang bral ba byung ste/ dge slong dag ston pa mig bzangs kyi nyan thos brgya phrag du ma dang / nyan thos stong phrag du ma dang / nyan thos brgya stong phrag du ma byung ste/ ston pa mig bzangs genyan thos rnams la shin tu dri ma dang bral ba dang / tshangs par spyod pa yongs su rdzogs par ston par mi byed kyi/ tshangs ris kyi lha dang skal ba mnyam pa ston te/ dge slong dag ston pa mig bzangs kyis khunyan thos bslab pa rnam pa thams cad kyi thams cad du sdogs pa de dag tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgoms dzanas 'dod pa la 'dun pa'i 'dod chags spangs shing phal cher gnas te/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye bar gyur to/ /gang gi rnam pa thams cad kyi thams cad du ma yin pa de dag las kha cig ni gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye bar 'gyur zhing / kha cig ni 'phrul dga' dang / kha cig ni 'thab bral dang / kha cig ni sum cu rtsa gsum dang / kha cig ni rgyal chen rigs 8bzhi dang / rgyal rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu rnams dang / bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu rnams dang / khyim bdag shing sā la chen po lta bu rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye bar gyur to/ /de nas ston pa mig bzangs 'di snyam 9 du bdag nyan thos rnams dang lhan cig 'gro ba 82—250
