dag yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mngon par rtogs pa'i kye rim gyis ston pa'i phyir mche ba byin gyis phra ba dag yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni shes rab mthon po'i /kyesar zhugs pa'i phyir shangs mtho ba dag yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni gdul bya gtsang sme'i rkye skye bo dang ldan pa'i phyir shangs gtsang ba dag yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi chos shin tu rgya chen po dang ldan pa'i phyir sbyan yangs pa dag yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sku thams cad kun du stug pa'i phyir dze+e ma stug pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mig dkar nag 'byes 4shing pad+ma'i 'dab ma rangs pa lta bu'i lha dang lha ma yin dang / mi gzhon nu rnams kyis mchog tu dga' bar bya ba'i phyir sbyan dkar nag 'byes kyeshing pad+ma'i 'dab ma lta bu dag yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rtag tu mdun phyogs su gzigs pa'i phyir smin tshugs ring ba dag 3yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'jam par 'dul ba la mkhas pa'i phyir rdzi ma 'jam pa dag yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni skyon kun du mkhyen pa'i phyir smin ma'i spu mnyam pa dag yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni dge ba'i rtsa ba 'jam zhing mnyen pas 2skye bo'i rgyud 'dul bar byed pa'i phyir dz+ren ma snum pa dag yin no / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos mchog tu don dang ldan pa mnga' ba'i phyir snyan shal sbug cing snyan shal 1ring ba dag yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyir snyan mnyam sbyi pa dag yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni gdul bya rgyud ma 82—301

nyams khyepa mnga' ba'i phyir snyan gyi dbang po ma nyams pa dag bluyin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni lta bar song ba thams cad yongs su spangs pa'i phyir dpral ba legs par 'byes 3pa dag yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni dge sbyong dang bram ze dang pha rol rgol ba rnam par gnon pa'i phyir dpral ba'i dbyes che ba dag yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni smon lam yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir dbu shin tu rgyas pa dag yin no—/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni yul gyi skye bo la rnam par chags pa log pa'i phyir dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag pa dag ④yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mthong ba dang bsgom pas spang bar mibya ba'i phra rgyas spangs pa'i phyir dbu skra stug pa dag yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos dkar pos ma skyes pa'i bstan pa'i ro dang ldan pa'i phyir dbu skra 'jam pa dag yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rtag tu ma 'dzings pa'i thugs dang ldan pa'i phyir dbu skra ma 'dzings pa dag yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rtag tu tshig rtsub spangs pa'i phyir dbu skra mi bshor 6ba dag yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni skye bo byang chub kyi yan lag gi dri zhim pos rjes su mthun par 'jug pa'i phyir dbu skra dri zhim pa dag yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni phyag dang zhabs kyi mthil na dpal gyi be+e'u dang g.yung drung 'khyil pa mnga' ba'i phyir dpal gyi be+e'u dang g.yung drung 'khyil pas brgyan pa dag yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dpe byad bzang po 'di dag dang ldan no/ /de nyid du gzhan du gnas brtan klu sgrub kyis yi ge gzhan dang tshig 'bru 82—302

gzhan gyis rnam par bshad de/ ji skad du/ sangs rgyas yang dag dpe byad brgyad cu po/ /nga yis rab bshad yid la dad skyed nyon/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes rab brjod pa/ /sen mo zangs lkumadog snum dang sen mo mtho/ /smra mchog rtsa mi mngon zhing rtsa yi geni/ /mdud pa mi mngon long bu mi mngon pa/ /ri dwags rgyal dang klu yi stabs dag tu/ /rnam par gshegs shing zhabs la mi mnyam med/ /khyu mchog ngang pa'i rgyal po'i stabs dang ni/ /g.yas su ldog cing mdzes par gshegs pa dang / /bye dor byas 'dra rim par 'tsham pa'i sku/ /ma yo ba dang 'khril bag chags pa dang / /kho lag yangs shing bzang dang gzhan yang ni/ /dpe byad yongs su rdzogs dang gom nga byesnyoms dang / /dku ④zhum med dang gtsang zhing 'jam pa dang / /gzhon sha chags shing sgu ni rnam par dag /yan lag nying lag shin tu rnam 'byes brushing / /thub pa'i dbang po shin tu grims pa'i sku/ /gzigs pa rab rib med cing rnam par ni/ /dag cing rab tu rgyas pa'i sku mnga' ba/ /sgu ni 'bar 'bur med cing skabs phyin dang / /phyang nge'i phyal dang lte ba'i bug pa zab/ /shin tu kun nas blta na rab mdzes shing / /lte ba g.yas kyi phyogs su 'khyil ba dang / /rgyal ba kun du spyod pa rab gtsang zhing ce/ /sme ba gnag bag smad du med pa dang / /ljags mnyen srab cing zhal gyi gzugs brnyan 'char/ /rgyal ba'i zhal ni ha cang ring ba min 3//glang chen nga ro 'brug gi sgra dang ni/ /mnyam pa'i dbyangs kyi mchog dang ldan pa dang / /shing bal ltar 'jam shin tu gzhon sha can/ /phyag gi ri mo dmar zhing zab pa dang / /phyag gi ri mo yo ba ma yin dang / /phyag gi ri mo mchog tu yangs pa dang / /shin tu snyan cing mnyen zul 'jam pa'i gsung / /mche ba 82—303

zlum zhing mche ba rno ba dang / /mche ba dkar zhing mche ba mnyam pa dang / /thub pa seng ge'i mche ba byin kyis phra/ /tshems ni shin tu dkar zhing gtsang ba dang / /spyan yangs pa dang rji ma stug pa dang / /'jam zhing shin tu yangs la mi dkar dang / /smin ma'i spu ni snum zhing 'jam pa dang / /snyan shal stug tsa cing ring la snyan mnyam 3dang / /bcom ldan snyan gyi dbang po ma nyams dang / /dpral ba shin tu legs par 'byes pa dang / /dbu ni rgyas la yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /dbu skra bung ba snum zhing dri zhim dang / /dbu skra 'jam zhing yongs su ma 'dzings dang / /dpal gyi be'u dang g.yung drung 'khyel pa yis sangs rgyas dbu skra rnam par brgyan pa yin/ /gang gis mtshan rnams gsal byed pa/ /sangs rgyas yang dag dpe byad ni/ /bzang po brgyad cu 'di dag ste/ /bde gshegs thams cad gsal byed yin/ /mtshan mchog sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i sku/ /sangs rgyas rjes su mi dran gang / /'di dang pha rol gnyis kar mnyam4/ /gzhan yang slob dbon sna tshogs blo gros kyis ji skad du/ bdag nyid snod mchog nyid du gzigs nas ni/ /bdag nyid yon gnas nyid du zhal 'ches te/ /'di ltar khyod kyis rtswa spyamachog tsam yang ni/ /sbyin bdag dbul ba de yang ma bkag gnang / /gal te bgos na phyag g.yas brkyang nas ni/ /phyag g.yas rjes su gzung ba'i rjes mthun byed/ /khyod la dpe byad brgyad cus bstod pa yis/ /ji ltar bdag kyang rjes su gzung bar mdzod/ /mnga' bdag khyod kyi sku yi stobs kyi tshad/ /gzhal nus 'jig rten gsum na 'ga' med 'dod/ /gus pa'i rnam pa'i 'byor pa 'di 'dra zhes/ /'phags pa gang phyir bdag 'dra ba yang gnasakhye/ /khyod kyi 7sor mo ri yi spor 82—304

gnas pa/ /sen mo zangs kyi mdog 'dra 'od zer can/ /pad+ma rā ga mdzes pa'i zla shar nas/ /gser gyi rang bzhin snying po mdzes par byas/ /rtse ltar mtho zhing phra la mnyam zhing 'phro/ /dbyangs bcas 'od gsal sen mo mdzes par byas/ /legs spyes ut+pal dmar po'i 'dab ma ltar/ /lto ba ma grums ma chag dzomanyam zhing mtho/ /steng du sdug mnyen 3dpal gyis bsdums pa ltar/ /shin tu gsal ba'i mdangs kyis rnam par mdzes/ /lha mi phyag byed tshe na skad cig la/ /skyes bu 'dul ba'i sen mo me long bzhin/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyi bstod pa snyan dngags kyi rgyan dang bcas pa blta bar bya'o / /gnas brtan thogs med kyis theg pa chen po'i chos mngon pa'i bstan bcos rnal 'byor spyod pa zhes bya ba las byang chub sems dpa'i sar mtshan dang dpe byad kyi le'u las/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu 'jig rten dang thun mong du bshad pa ni khyad par du 'phags pa ma brjod pa'i phyir mngon par dad par byed pa ma yin pas mi gzung ngo / /dpe byad bzang po 'di dag legs pa dang / legs pa ma yin pa rnam par gzhag pa ni slob dpon go chas byin gyis snyoms par 'jug pa'i phung po rnam par bshad pa dbugs dbyung 4ba bzhi par rgyas par bshad pa blta bar bya'o / /5dper na rgyal po kṛ shī'i 6rmi lam thun bcu zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/gser phreng can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa las 'di ltar 'don te/ de nas rgyal po kṛ kri 3yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srungs ༷gang na ba der nye bar song ste nye bar song nas/ bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi 9zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug 82—305

go / /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srungs la rgyal po kṛ tīs tsho'adi skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa mdang bdag mtshan mo rmi lam na rmi lam thun bcu mthong ste/ btsun pa glang po che chen po skar khung nas byung ba la mjug ma thogs pa dang / skom pa ma yin pa rnams kyi phyi bzhin du khron pa gda' 3ba dang / phye bre gang dang mu tig bye gang brje ba dang / tsan dan shing tha mal pa la 'tshong ba dang / kun dga' ra ba gre tog dang 'bras bu phun sum tshogs la me tog dang 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa de ni lduthams cad ma byin par len pas phrogs pa dang / glang po che 4/chung ngus spos kyi glang po che bsdigs pa dang / spre'u mi gtsang bas 3'bags pa gzhan la sgud pa dang / spre'u rgyal por dbang bskur ba dang / snam bu gcig mi bco brgyad kyis bgos pa 6la snam bu yang de de )bzhin du gnas pa dang / skye bo phal po che'i tshogs 'dus te tshig ngan brjod cing chad pa dang gnod pa byed pa bdag gis mthong ngo / /mthong nas bdag rgyal srid las nyams pa'am/ srog gi bar chad du 'gyur du 'ong zhes bdag rengs shing 'jigs pa dang / skrag par gyur to/ /de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyis she'adi skad ces bka' sprul to/ /rgyal po chen po ma 'jigs shig rgyu 'di las khyod rgyal srid las nyams pa dang / srog gi bar chad du mi 'gyur gyi (ma 'jigs shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyal bo chen po gang khyod kyis glang po che skar khung nas byung ba la mjug ma thogs pa mthong ba de ci'i snga ltas she tren/ ma 'ongs pa na skye dgu'i 9tshe lo brgya thub pa'i dus na shākya thub pa zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de'i 82—306

nyan thos dag rang gi skye bo gnyen bshes 1rgya chen po spangs nas rab tu byung ste/de ltar rab tu byung nas gtsug lag khang la khyim gyi 'du shes skye bar 'gyur zhing /de nas ser sna kun du bsten cing lan mang du byas pas lus zhig ste shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song ngan 'gro rnams su ltung zhing skye bar 'gyur ba de'i snga ltas yin no/ /rgyal bo chen po khyod kyis skom pa ma yin pa rnams kyi phyi bzhin du khron pa gda' byeb rmi lam du mthong ba de ci'i snga ltas she bye na/ de'i nyan thos dag bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams la chos ston pa de dag nyan par mi 'dod cing gnas par 'gyur ba de'i snga ltas so/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis phye bye gang dang mu tig bye gang brje ba rmi lam du mthong ba de ci'i snga ltas she sgon/ de'i nyan thos phye tshol ba'i phyir dbang po dang stobs dang byang chub kyi hūṃyan lag la sogs pa'i rin po che yang dag par gsal bar byed de/ de'i snga ltas so/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis tsan dan shing tha mal par 'tshong 3ba rmi lam du mthong ba de ci'i snga ltas she phyan / de'i nyan thos dag lus ma bsgoms pa 'byung bar 'gyur zhing / tshul khrims ma bsgoms pa dang / sems ma bsgoms pa dang / shes rab ma bsgoms pa dag 'byung bar 'gyur la/ lus ma bsgoms pa dang / tshul khrims ma bsgoms pa dang / sems ma bsgoms pa dang / shes rab ma bsgoms pas mu stegs kyi bstan pa 'dzin cing sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab dang mnyam par byed par 'gyur te/ de'i snga ltas so/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis kun dga' ra ba me tog dang 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa dag ma byin par len pas phrogs pa rmi lam du mthong ba de ci'i snga ltas she shen/ de'i nyan thos khyim la brten te dge 'dun gyi me tog dang 'bras bu btsongs shing btsongs te bzung nas 'tsho ba'i 82—307

phyir sems pa dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de ni de'i snga ltas so/ /rgyal po chen po gang khyod kyis glang po chung ngus spos kyi glang po chen po skrag par byed pa de rmi lam du mthong ba hūṃde ci'i snga ltas she 3na/ de'i nyan thos tshul khrims 'chal pa sdig pa'i chos can dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ des gang dag dge slong tshul khrims dang ldan pa yon tan dang ldan pa/ des shing dge ba de dag bskrad nas gnas gzhan na gnas par 'gyur te/ de ni de'i snga ltas so/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis spre'u mi gtsang bas 'bags — ༷pa gzhan la skud pa rmis pa de ci'i snga ltas she 4na/ de'i nyan thos sdig pa'i chos can tshul khrims 'chal pa de dag gis dge slong tshul khrims dang ldan pa yon tan dang ldan pa des shing dge ba'i chos can dag la mi bden pa'i skyon 'gel bar 'gyur te/ de'i snga ltas so/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis spre'u rgyal por dbang bskur ba rmis pa de ci'i snga ltas she 5na / de'i dus na ma ning yang rgyal po byed par 'gyur te/ de'i snga ltas so/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis snam bu gcig mi bco brgyad kyis bgos la snam bu yang de bzhin du gnas pa rmi lam du mthong ba de ci'i snga ltas she 9na/ de'i bstan pa kha bco brgyad du gyes par gyur 4la rnam par grol ba'i snam bu ni ral bar mi 'gyur te/ de'i snga ltas so/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis gang skye bo phal po che'i tshogs 'dus shing tshig ngan brjod de/ chad pa dang gnod pa byed pa rmi lam du mthong ba de ci'i snga ltas she na/ de'i bstan nga/ lo stong du gnas shing ngan par smra ba dang chad pa byed pas nub par 'gyur te/ de'i snga ltas yin te/ de'i phyir khyod rgyal srid 9nyams pa'am/ srog gi bar chad du mi 'gyur gyi rgyal po chen po ma 'jigs shig /de nas rgyal po kṛ shī 7yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 82—308

sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyis dbugs phyung nas mngon par rab tu dad par gyur to zhes 'byung ngo // //dge slong ma dkar mo yang gos dang bcas par yin te zhes bya ba la/bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i shing n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs te/ nge nas shākya'i nang na shākya skyed pa zhes bya ba yod de/ phyug cing zhes bya ba nas de de dang lhan cig tu k+ṇirtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ yongs su spyod par byed pa las 'ebu yang med bu mo yang me+ed ces bya ba'i bar du'o/ /de bu mngon par 'dod pas zhi ba dang chu lha dang / rnam thos kyi bu dang khyim gyi lha la sogs pa lha stong phrag du ma la gsol ba 'debs par byed kyang bu ma skyes so/ /ji tsam du dus gzhan zhig na rtse dga' bar byed byung yongs su spyod par byed do/ /de rtse dga' zhing yongs su spyod par byed pa las dus gzhan zhig na chung ma sems can dang ldan par gyur to/ /des chung ma la smras pa/ bzang mo gal te bu pho skyes na de lta na legs/ 'di ltar bu mo skyes na lhan cig bskrad par bya'o/ /ji tsam na zla ba dgu 'das pa'i 'og tu de'i chung ma la bu mo gzugs bzang la mdzes shing blta na sbug pa mi'i kha dog las 'das pa lha'i kha dog ④thob pa gos dkar pos g.yogs pa/ mngal gyi nyes pas ma gos pa zhig btsas so/ /ji tsam na chung ma la bu mo btsas pa thos nas khro ba dang bcas pas nang du zhugs pa dang / rked pa lha'i gos kyis dkris pa'i bu mo de byin pa dang / shākyas bu mo de mthong nas ngo mtshar skyes par gyur to/ /de btsas pa'i btsas ston dag byas te ming 'dogs par byed pa na/ kye shes ldan dag bu mo 'di'i ming ci 'ugadags—/ gnyen rnams kyis smras pa gang gi trephyir bu mo ni /hūṃgos dkar po 82—309

dang bcas par skyes pa de'i phyir bu mo 'di'i ming dkar mo zhes gdags so/ /bu mo dkar mo ji lta ji ltar ches skyes pa de lta de ltar gos kyang skye zhing dri ma dang bral bar gyur to/ /de'i lus la rdul dang dri mas mi gos par gyur to/ /gang gi tshe bu mo dkar mo rim gyis chen por gyur pa de'i tshe/ de la rgyal po'i bu dang /blon po'i bu dang / phyug po'i bu dag gis slong du 'ongs shing de dag gis gtses pa dang / gal te ngas ma byin na 'gras par 1'gyur ro zhes de'i pha khyelag pa 'gram pa 'a/ gtad de de bye sems khong du chud cing 'dug par gyur to/ /ji tsam na bu mos pha sems shing 'dug pa mthong nas/ pha ci zhig sems/ de la des don 4dag rgyas par brjod pa dang / bu mos smras pa/ pha 'di snyed bya ci dgos/ bdag ni 'dod pa don du gnyer ba ma yin gyitre/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu 'byung tregis pha mkhyen par ghumadzod cig /de ji srid du pha dang mas gnang nas rab tu byung ste/ gos gang gis dkris te skyes pa de nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i chos gos lnga par gyur to/ /des sbyor zhing brtson pa dang 'dun cing 'bad pas rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i 'gro ba lnga'i 'khor ba 'di nyid rab tu rig nas 'khor ba'i 'du byed thams cad rul sab dang lhung ba dang rnam par 'gyur ba dang 'jig (pa'i chos can spangs te/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs shing khams gsum las 'dod chags dang bral ba hūṃ gser dang bong ba/nam mkha' dang lag mthil/ tsan+dan dang ste'u ru mtshungs shing rig pa dang /rnam par krol ba'i spobs pa can rnyed pa dang bkur ste la kha phyir phyogs pa lha'i dbang pos mchod cing gus par bya ba dgra bcom pa nyid mngon du byas so/ /dge slong rnams je tshom (5skyes nas the tshom rtathams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas 82—310

bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa dkar mos las ci zhig byas nas gang gis na phyug po'i rigs su skyes shing gzugs bzang zhing mdzes pa dang blta na sdug par gyur/ ci zhig byas pas na gos dkar pos dkris bzhin du skyes shing dgra bcom pa nyid mngon du byas par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sprul pa / dge slong dag dkar mo nyid kyis skye ba snga ma la las byas shing bsags la so sor thob par byas pa chu bo bzhin du nye bar gnas pa ste/ gzhan gyis byas shing bsags pa gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu dang me dang rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur gyi/'on kyang las byas shing bsags pa ni zin pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/ lus can dag gi 51las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la/ skye dgu rnams tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa bla na med pa skyes bu 'dul zhing kha lo sgyur ba lha dang mi rnams kyi 3ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srungs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de bā rā ṇa sī'i rngugrong khyer drang srong smra ba ri dwags kyi nags na brten zhing ④bzhugs so/ /ji tsam na phyug po'i chung ma thu dad pa can rang bzhin bzang zhing dge ba'i bsam pa can zhig /bya ba 'ga' zhig gi hūṃphyir drang srong smra ba ri dwags kyi nags su 'ongs so/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum 82—311

cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus sku rnam par brgyan pa nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i gzi brjid can byon pa/ rin po che'i ri bo lta bu'i 'od zer kun nas 'bar ba dang bcas shing hūṃbalta bar bya ba'i bcom ldan 'das de 3mthong nas zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas nas chos mnyan pa'i phyir phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyis chos bstan nas/ bcom ldan 'das la mngon par dad de /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa gdugs tshod gsol nas dge slong gi dge 'dun la chos gos phul te/ rim gyis pha dang mas rjes su gnang nas bcom ldan 'das de'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ngo / /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ phyug po'i chung ma de nyid dge slong ma dkar mo yin no/ /dge slong gi dge 'dun la sra d+nghabarkyang gi chos gos phul bas gos dkar pos dkris bzhin du skyes shing tshangs par spyod pa yongs su dze+egs shing yongs su bsrungs pa des na skye ba bcom zhing dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu gnag 5pa yin zhing / gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi ni gcig tu dkar ba/ 'dren ma rnams kyi ni 'dren ma yin pa de'i phyir dge slong dag las gcig tu gnag pa'i las rnams dang / 'dren ma rnams spang bar bya zhing /gcig tu dkar ba'i las rnams yongs su spyad par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong dag bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga' zhing rjes su yi rang ngo / /9bcom ldan 'das kyis sems can rnams kyi las kyi rnam par smin pa ni

bsam gyis mi khyab bo zhes gsungs so zhes bya ba la/ bzhi las 'phros pa'i sgo lnga pa las sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i mdo las bsam par bya ba rnam pa hūṃganyis te bshad pa dang / 'di nyid du yang go rims las bzlog pa'i mdzod kyi gnas gnyis par bshad pa lta bu'o / /btab 3pa las 'di skad du zhes bya ba la/mdzod kyi gnas gnyis pa dbang po'i rnam par bshad pa phra rgyas btab pa las 5bshad pa bzhin no / /je pha ma'i nur nur bo'i mi phyegatsang ba las skyes zhes bya ba la/ gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bos te / dge slong dag 'di lta ste/ 'di na sbrul gdug pa gzi brjid drag pa/dug drag pa bzhi sgrom cig 6gi nang du bcug par gyur cing / de nas skyes bu byis pa'i rang bzhin ma yin pa/ rmongs pa ma yin zhing yang dag pa'i shes pa dang ldan pa bde ba 'dod cing sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa 'tsho bar 'dod cing /'tsho ba dang rjes su mthun pa 'ga' zhig 'ongs te/ de la gzhan kha cig gis 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye skyes bu sbrul gdug pa gzi brjid drag cing dug drag pa bzhi sgom cig 7gi nang du bcug cing khyod kyis de la dus dus su byug par bya/dus dus su khrus bya 8zhing / dus dus su zas sbyin par bya zhing / dus dus su yang dag par bde ba la sbyar bar bya'o/ /kye skyes bu gang gi tshe sbrul gdug pa gzi brjid drag cing dug drag pa bzhi po 'di dag las gang yang rung ba zhig khros par gyur na de'i rgyus khyod 'chi ba'am 'chi ba la thug pa tsam gyi snyug bsngal nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro/ /kye skyes bu khyod bdag nyid kyi bya ba gang yin pa de byos shig ces smras na/ de nas skyes bu de sbrul gdug pa gzi brjid che zhing dug drag 82—313

pa bzhi sgom gyi nang du bcug pas 'jigs nas/ gang gis na myur ba myur bar 'bros par byed pa na skyes bu gzhan zhig gis kye skyes bu khyod kyi phyi bzhin du bdar 'ong gi ①des khyod la gnod pa'am gnod par 'gyur gyi ⑤kye skyes bu khyod rang gi bya ba gang yin pa de byos shig ces smras pa dang / de nas skyes bu de sbrul gdug pa gzi brjid che zhing dug drag pa bzhi sgom cig ④gi nang du bcug pa dang /gshed ma'i skyes bu lag na ral gri thogs pa lngas rab tu 'jigs te gang gi na myur ba myur bar 'bros pa na/ skyes bu gzhan zhig gis kye ④skyes bu gshed ma'i 5skyes bu drug pa zhig gis phyi nas snyeg cing phyi nas nye bar 'ongs shing 'dug gi'u/des khyod kyi mgo drungs nas bcad de sa la bsgyur bar 'gyur gyiphyo/ kye skyes bu khyod rang gi bya ba gang yin pa de byos shig ces smras pa dang / sbrul gdug pa gzi brjid che ba bzhi sgom cig gi nang du bcug pa dang / gshed ma'i skyes bu lag na ral gri thogs pa lnga dang / gshed ma'i skyes bu drug pa drung na nye ba de dag gis shin tu 'jigs te myur ba myur bar bros 7bhepa dang / des de 6na grong stong yepa zhig mthong ngo / /de grong stong pa der zhugs te/ ji srid du khang pa stong pa der bltas pa na stong pa 'ba' zhig mthong ste/ brdzun pa nyid dang /slu rkemib nyid dang / snying po med pa nyid mthong zhing gang gnod pa mthong ba de dag kyang brdzun pa dang / slu tsuX ba dang / snying po med par mthong ba la skyes bu gzhan zhig 'di skad ces/ kye skyes bu khang pa stong pa 'dir grong la gnod pa'i rkun ma 'byung bar 'gyur kyi snye des khyod bzung nas rnam pa thams cad kyi thams cad du srog dang phral bar 'gyur gyi/ kye tsheskyes bu khyod rang gi bya ba gang yin pa de byos shig ces smras pa dang / de nas skyes bu de sbrul gdug pa bzhi 82—314

zhes bya bas/ gshed ma'i skyes bu drung na nye ba dang / grong stong pa la gnod pa'i rkun ma dag gis rab tu 'jigs te myur ba nyumyur bar bros pa na/ des de na chu bo chen po ri las 'bar ba'i chu bo rgyun ring zhing gting zab pa phyamyur bar 'gro zhing khyer bar bya ba khyer bar byed pa tshu rol gyi ngogs dogs pa dang bcas pa 'jigs pa dang bcas pa 'jigs pa bye tha dad pas 'jigs su rung bar gyur cing / pha rol gyi ngogs zhi zhing bde ba grub pa dang / bde ba dang bcas pa de tshu rol gyi ngogs las pha rol gyi ngogs su rgal 5bar byed par gru'am gzings thu med par gyur cing / de lta bu'i chu bo chen po ri las 'bab pa'i chu bo rgyun ring zhing gting zab pa 'umyur bar 'gro zhing khyer bar bya ba khyer bar byed pa tshu rol gyi ngogs dogs pa dang bcas pa 'jigs pa dang bcas pa 'jigs pa tha dad pas 'jigs su rung bar gyur cing / pha rol gyi ngogs zhi zhing bde ba grub pa dang bde ba dang bcas pa 'di las pha rol du rgal 3bar byed par gru'am gzings ldugang dag gis rtswa'am shing ngam yal ga dang 'dab ma dag bsdus te gzings spusu zhugs shing / gzings la brten te lag pa dang / rkang pa'i rtsol ba brtsam par bya'o zhes de snyam du bsams nas/ rtswa dang shing dang tso'adab ma dang lo ma dag phyogs gcig tu basbus te/ gzings 'ching bar byed de/ gzings bcings te/ gzings la zhugs shing gzings la brten gzings la gnas te/lag pa dang rkang pa'i rtsol ba rtsom par byed de/ ji ltar lag pa dang rkang pa'i rtsol ba rtsom par byed pa de ltar sgom spangs shing sbrul gdug pa gzi brjid che zhing dug drag pa bzhi sgrom cig skyegi nang du bcug pa spangs par gyur cig /gshed ma'i skyes bu lag na ral gri thogs pa spangs par gyur cing / gshed ma'i skyes bu 82—315

drug pa drung na nye bar spangs shing / khang pa stong pa spangs shing / grong 'joms pa'i rkun ma spangs par gyur cing / chu bo chen po ri las 'bab cing rgyun ring la gting zab pa myur bar 'gro zhing khyer bar bya ba khyer bar byed pa ring du spangs par gyur cing / tshu rol gyi ngogs dogs pa dang bcas pa 'jigs pa dang bcas pa 'jigs pa tha dad pas 'jigs su rung ba spangs shing ring du byas par 'gyur zhing / pha rol gyi ngogs zhi zhing bde ba dang grub pa dang bde legs su brgal nas pha rol tu phyin te tshangs shing gnas so/ /dge slong dag 'di ni ji srid du don shes par bya ba'i phyir dper byas pa yin kyi/'di'i don ni gzhan du blta bar bya ste/ dge slong dag sgrom cig ces hūṃbya ba ni lus kyi tshig bla dwags te/ gzugs can rags pa 'byung ba chen po bzhi las gyur pa/ pha dang ma'i mi gtsang ba nur nur po las brten te skyes pa/ 'bras chan dang zan dron gyis gsos pa/ rtag par rgyun du brdzun pa slu /shub yongs su 'jig pa'i chos can gyi tshig bla dwags so/ /sbrul gdug pa bzhi zhes bya ba ni 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i tshig bla dwags so/ /de bzhi gang zhe na/ sa dang /chu dang / me dang / rlung ngo / /dge slong dag sa'i khams 'khrugs na yang 'chi ba'am 'chi ba la thug pa tsam gyi na sbug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ro/ /gshed ma'i skyes bu lag na ral gri thogs pa lnga zhes bya ba ni nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga'i tshig bla dwags so/ /gshed ma'i skyes bu drug pa drung na nye ba zhes bya ba ni 'dod chags kyi tshig bla dwags so/ /grong stong pa zhes bya ba ni nang gi bdag nyid kyi skye mched rnams kyi tshig bla dwags so/ /dge slong dag dge slong rigs kyi bu mig la stong pa nyid du lta ④bar byed cing dge slong dag rna ba dang / sna dang / lce 82—316

dang / lus dang / yid la rigs kyi bu de lta bas na stong pa nyid du mthong bar 'gyur zhing brdzun pa nyid dang / slu ba nyid dang / snying po med pa ①nyid du mthong bar 'gyur zhing / dge slong dag rigs kyi bu mig la shin tu brdzun pa dang / slu 3ba dang / gsog dang / snying po med par mthong bar 'gyur zhing / dge slong dag rigs kyi bu rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang /lus dang / yid la shin tu brdzun pa dang / slu rngub dang / gsog dang snying po med pa nyid du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /grong 'joms pa'i rkun po zhes bya ba ni phyi'i skye mched rnams kyi tshig bla dwags te/ gzugs yid du 'ong ba dang mi 'ong bas mig 'joms par byed do/ /rna ba sgras sna dris lce ros/ lus reg byas dge slong dag yid ni chos yid byadu 'ong ba dang mi 'ong ba rnams kyis 'joms par byed do/ /dge slong dag chu bo chen po zhes bya ba ni chu bo bzhi po 'dod pa'i chu bo dang / srid pa'i chu bo dang / lta ba'i chu bo dang / ma rig pa'i chu bo'i tshig bla dwags so/ /dge slong dag rgyun ring po zhes bya ba ni srid pa gsum po 'dod pa'i srid pa dang / gzugs kyi srid pa dang / gzugs med pa'i srid pa gsum gyi tshig bla dwags so/ /tshu rol gye 'gram dogs pa dang bcas pa 'jigs pa dang bcas pa 'jigs phyepa tha dad pas 'jigs su rung ba zhes bya ba ni 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i tshig bla dwags so/ /pha rol gyi 'gram zhi zhing bde ba grub pa dang bde ba dang skyebacas pa zhes bya ba ni phung po lhag ma dang bcas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshig bla dwags so/ /gzings zhes bya ba ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad kyi tshig bla dwags so/ /lag pa dang rkang pa'i rtsol ba rtsom pa zhes bya ba ni brtson 'grus brtsams pa'i tshig bla dwags so/ /pha 82—317

rol tu phyin cing rgal gyo la tshangs shing gnas so zhes bya ba rgo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi tshig bla dwags so/ /dge slong dag nyan thos rnams kyis ⑤dran par bya'o zhes bya ba nas/ 'di ni nga'i rjes su bstan pa'o zhes bya ba'i bar du gsungs so/ /kun dga' bo la gdams pa las kyang kun dga' bo la bye gdams pa 'di ltar 'don te/ sring mo lus zhes bya ba ni lus kyi tshig bla dwags te/ gzugs can rags pa 'byung ba chen po bzhi las gyur pa pha'i mi gtsang ba nur nur po las skyes pa 'bras chan dang zan dron gyis bskyed ngacing rtag tu 'drul shezhing yongs su nyams pa 'jig cing rnam par 'gyur ba'i chos can gye tshig bla dwags so/ /de bzhin du gzhan las kyang ngo / / ⑥dge slong dag khyed kyis yun ring por zhes bya ba la sogs pa la bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can spre'u rdzing gi gtsug lag lngakhang du bzhugs te/ de nas lam du gnas pa bzhi bcu po thams cad kyang dgon pa pa/ bsod snyoms pa/phyis mi len pa/ 3slob pa 'dod pa las 'dod chags dang bral ba dag yin la/gang bdag gis 'di dag 'di 'un 'dug bzhin du ji ltar nye bar len pa med par zag pa dag las sems rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bshad par bya'o snyam du dgongs nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong bzhi bcu'i tshogs la bos te/ dge slong dag sems can thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i 'khor bar ma rig pas bsgribs shing sred pas rngokun du spyor ba⑪/ sred pas bcings pa yun ring po nas 'khor bar nying mtshams spyor zhing 'khor ba rnams kyi sdug bsngal gyi sngon gyi mtha' mi shes so/ /dge slong dag 'di ji snya ma du sems/'di ltar chu bo gaṅgā gang nas 'bab pa rgya mtsho chen po gang du 'jug pa de'i bar 82—318

gyi ①gaṅgā'i chu mang ngam/ gang yang khyed cag gi yun ring po'i dus na 'khor bar khyanying mtshams spyor ba'i khrag zags par gyur pa mang / btsun pa ji ltar bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa'i don 'tshal ba ltar na/ 'di ltar chu bo chen po gaṅgā gang nas 'bab pa dang / rgya mtsho chen po gang du 'jug pa de'i bar gyi grugaṅgā'i— chu bas bdag cag gi yun ring por 'khor bar nying mtshams sbyor ba'i khrag 'dzag pa 'di ④nyid ches mang ngo / /dge slong dag legs so legs so/ /'di ltar chu bo gaṅgā gang nas 'bab pa dang / rgya mtsho chen po gang du 'jug pa de'i bar gyi ⑤gaṅgā'i chu bas khyod cag gi yun ring por 'khor bar nying mtshams sbyor ba'i khrag zags par gyur pa ches mang ngo / /dge slong dag 'di ji snyam du sems/ 'di ltar chu bo gaṅgā gang nas 'bab pa dang /rgya mtsho chen po spyogang du 'jug pa de'i bar gyi gaṅgā'i chu dang / gang ya nga shar phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen po dang / lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen po bzhi'i chu mang ngam/ gang yang khyed cag gi yun ring por 'khor bar nying mtshams sbyor ba'i khrag zags hūṃpa mang / btsun pa ji ltar bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa'i don 'tshal ba ltar na 'di ltar na shechu bo gaṅgā gang nas 'bab pa dang / rgya mtsho chen po gang du 'jug pa de'i bar gyi shegaṅgā'i chu dang / gang yang shar phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen po dang / lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen po bzhi'i chu bas bdag cag gi yun ring por 'khor bar nying mtshams sbyor ba'i khrag zags par gyur pa ches mang ngo / /dge slong dag legs so legs so/ /'di ltar chu bo gaṅgā gang nas 'bab pa dang / rgya mtsho chen po gang du 'jug pa 82—319

de'i bar gyi gaṅgā'i chu bo dang / gang yang shar phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen po dang /lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen po bzhi'i chu bas khyed cag gi yun ring por 'khor bar nying mtshams sbyor ba'i khrag zags par gyur pa 'di nyid ches mang ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge slong dag khyed cag yun ring por glang po che dang skal ba mnyam khyepar skyes te/ glang po cher gyur cing lag pa bcad pa nyams su myong ba dang / rkang pa bcad pa dang /rna ba bcad pa dang / mgo bcad pa dang / so 'don pa lan du mar nyams su myong bar gyur cing / lan du mar khrag zags par gyur to/ /dge slong dag khyed cag khyi dang / rnga mo dang / ba lang dang / bong bu dang / ra dang / ri dwags dang / ma te dang / phag dang / khyim bya rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skyes shing khyem byar gyur te/ lag pa bcad pa nyams su stsong ba dang / rkang pa bcad pa dang / rna ba bcad pa dang / mgo bo bcad pa dang / mchu gcod par gyur pa'i sdug bsngal du ma nyams su myong bar gyur cing lan mang du khrag zags par gyur to/ /dge slong dag khyed cag yun ring por rkun mar gyur te bzung ba dang / mi byegazhan gyis bzung ba 'phrog pa dang /gzhan 'ching ba dang / rgyun gcod pa dang / bcings pa 'grol ba dang /chom rkun pa dang / grong 'joms pa dang / grong khyer 'joms pa dang /yul 'joms pa dang / ljongs 'joms pa yin no zhes bzung ba dang / der lan du mar lag pa bcad pa nyams su myong zhing / rkang pa bcad pa dang /rna ba bcad pa dang / sna bcad pa dang / mgo bo bcad pa nyams su myong zhing der lan du mar khrag zags par gyur to/ /dge slong dge slong dag spyod 82—320

kyis yun ring por sdug bsngal drag pa tsha ba rtsub pa yongs su myong zhing dur khrod skyed kledo/ /khrag gi thigs pa blangs so/ /lan cig ma yin par dmyal ba dang /lan cig ma yin par dud 'gro dang / lan cig ma yin par yi dwags dang /lan cig ma yin par ngan song ngan 'gro log par lhung 3bar gyur to/ /dge slong dag gzugs rtag pa'am mi rtag pa yin snyam du phyasems/ btsun pa 'di ni mi rtag pa'o/ /gang mi rtag pa de sdug bsngal ba yin nam/ btsun pa 'di ni sdug bsngal ba'o/ /gang mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yongs su 'gyur ba'i chos can de la 'phags pa nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa 'di ni bdag go 'di ni bdag ste/ 'di ni bdag gi'o zhes bdag tu khas len par byed dam/ btsun pa ma lags gyeso/ /dge slong dag 'di ji snyam du sems/tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa rtag pa 'amami rtag pa yin snyam du sems/ btsun pa 'di ni mi rtag pa'o/ /gang mi rtag pa de sdug bsngal ba'am/ sdug bsngal ba ma yin/ btsun pa sdug bsngal ba / gang mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yongs su 'gyur ba'i chos can de la 'phags pa nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa 'di ni bdag go/ /'di ni bdag ste/ 'di ni bdag gi'o zhes bdag khas len par byed dam/btsun pa ma lags so/ /dge slong dag de'i phyir gzugs gang 'das pa'am ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'am/ nang gi'am/ phyi'i 'am/ rags pa'am—/ phra ba'am/ dman pa'am/ gya nom pa'am/ thag nye ba'am/rgyang ring ba'am/ de thams cad la 'di ni bdag gi ma yin no/ /'di ni bdag gi ⑤ma yin te/ bdag gi bdag med do zhes 'di ltar yang dag pa'i 82—321

she sa rab kyis melta hubar bya'o/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa gang cung zad 'das pa'am/ ma 'ongs pa'am/da ltar byung glu ba'am/ nang gi'am/ phyi'i 'am/ rags pa'am/ phra ba'am/dman pa'am/ gya nom pa'am/ thag nye ba'am/ rgyang ring ba de thams cad la 'di ni bdag gi ma yin zhing bdag ma yin no/ /'di ni bdag gi ma yin no zhes 'di ltar yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis ji lta ba bzhin du — blta bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag de ltar mthong ba'i 'phags pa nyan thos thos ④pa dang ldan pa gzugs la yid 'byung zhing / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa la yid 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yid byung nas 'dod chags dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /'dod chags dang bral nas grol bar 'gyur ro/ /grol nas bdag gi skye ba zad do/ /tshangs par spyod pa bsten to/ /bya ba byas so—/ /yang srid pa 'di las gzhan 3mi shes so zhes/ rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa'i tshe dge slong bzhi ba cu'i tshogs rnams nye bar len pa med par zag pa dag las sems rnam par grol lo zhes gsungs so / /tre dmyal ba yi ni spyi skyetshugs yin/ /zhes bya ba la/ gleng gzhi dze+e mnyan du yod pa na'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bos te/dge slong dag yongs su gdung ba dang bcas pa dang / yongs su gdung ba med pa'i chos bstan par bya yis ga —de legs pa'i khunyon la yid la zung shig nyu snadang bshad par bya'o/ /yongs su gdung ba dang bcas pa'i chos gang yin zhe na/dge slong dag skyes pa'am bud med tshul —khrims 'chal pa sdig pa'i chos can 82—322

gang lus kyis /1 nyes par spyod pa'am/ ngag dang yid kyis nyes par spyod pa dang ldan pa dag 'di ltar 'gyur te/ de'i dus na nad kyis jebs kyeshing sdug bsngal zhing na la mal stan la 'dug cing khri dang stan gyi steng na 'dug pa la lus kyi tshor ba sdug bsngal ba drag pa tsha ba rtsub pa yid du mi 'o nga ba srog 'phrog par byed pa rnams kyis reg pa na gang yang de 'di ltar 'gyur te/ sngon gyi lus kyisazhunyes par spyad pa dang / ngag gis ④nyes par spyad pa dang yid kyis snyenyes par spyad pa de'i tshe de'i dus na mngon du 'gyur zhing ches gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste nyi ma nub pa'i dus na ri'am ri'i bang rim gyi grib ma sa la lhags par 'gyur6—/ rab tu lhags par 'gyurarmya / ches gsal bar lhags pa de bzhin du—/ de 'di ltar gang gi tshe sngon gyi lus kyis byenyes par spyad pa dang / ngag gis ⑪nyes par spyad pa dang / yid kyis tshunyes par spyad pa de'i tshe de'i dus na mngon sum du 'gyur te/ rab tu mngon du 'gyur zhing ches gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /de 'di snyam du kye ma 'di ltar bdag gis kyertalus dang ngag dang yid kyis sdig pa byas te/ sdig pa byas so/ /drag po byas so/ /nyes par skyebyas so/ /bsod nams ma byas so/ /dge ba ma byas shing 'jigs pa la mi 'jigs pa'i skyabs ma byas pas pha rol du 'gro bar 'gyur ro zhes 'gyod pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro0/ /'akyod pa dang bcas te shi ba ni legs pa ma yin zhing dus byed pa dang pha rol du 'gro ba ni legs pa ma yin no/ /'di ni 'gyod pa yongs su gdung ba dang bcas pa'i chos zhes bya'o/ /yongs su gdung ba med pa'i chos gang zhe na/ dge slong dag skyes pa'am bud med tshul khrims dang ldan pa dge ba'i chos can gang lus kyis legs par spyad pa dang / ngag gis legs par 82—323

spyad pa dang / yid kyis legs par spyad pa dang ldan pa dag 'di ltar 'gyur te/de'i dus na nad kyis thebs shing sdug bsngal zhing na la mal stan la 'dug cing khri dang stan kyi steng na 'dug pa la lus kyi rkyatshor ba sdug bsngal ba drag pa tsha ba rtsub pa yid du mi 'ong ba srog 'phrog par byed pa rnams kyis reg pa na gang yang de 'di ltar 'gyur te/ sngon lus kyis legs par spyad pa dang / ngag gis legs par spyad pa dang / yid kyis legs par sbyad pa de'i tshe na mngon du 'gyur zhing / rab tu mngon du 'gyur la/ ches gsal bar 'gyur te/'di lta ste/ nyi ma nub pa'i dus na ri'am ri'i bang rim kyi grib ma sa la lhags par 'gyur1/ rab tu lhags par 'gyur ches gsal bar lhags pa de bzhin du bye 'di ltar gang sngon ④lus kyis ldulegs par spyad pa dang / ngag gis legs par spyad pa dang / yid kyis legs par spyad pa de'i tshe de'i dus na mngon du 'gyur te—/ rab tu mngon du 'gyur zhing ches gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /de 'di snyam du kye ma bdag gis 'di ltar lus dang ngag dang yid kyis rjodage ba byas te/sdig pa drag po ma byas so/ /bsod nams byas so/ /dge ba byas shing 'jigs pa la mi 'jigs pa'i skyabs byas te ⑦'jig rten pha rol du 'go bar 'gyur ro zhes 'gyod pa rnged par 'gyur te/ 'gyod pa med par shi ba ni legs shing dus byed pa dang pha rol du rkye'agro ba ni legs pa yin te/ 'di 'gyod pa yongs su gdung ba med pa'i chos zhes bya'o/ /dge slong dag yongs su gdung ba dang bcas pa dang / yongs su gdung ba med pa'i chos bshad par bya'o zhes ji skad du bshad pa de rgyas par rab tu bshad do/ /'gyod pa dang bcas mi rnams kyi—/ /'tsho ba shin tu dka' bar gnas/ /mi de rnams kyi 'gro ba dag /82—324

gang du 'gro ba legs par nyon/ /yang sos dang ni thig nag dang / /bsdus 'joms ngu 'bod gnyis dang ni/ /tsha dang rab tu tsha ba dang / /mnar med pa zhes bya ba ste/ /de ltar de dag dmyal ba ni/ /brgyad ces bya ste rgal 1bar dka'—/ /drag po'i las kyis kun du 1gang / /re re la yang lhag bcu drug /rtsig pa bzhi dang sgo bzhi dang / /rnam phyed ༷ ris su chad pa yin/ /lcags kyi ra bas kun nas bskor/ /lcags dag gis ni gang ba yin/ /de nas lcags 'bar sa gzhi ste/ /'bar ba'i me dang ldan pa yin/ /dpag tshad stong phrag du mar ni/ /me lce dag gis khyab par gnas/ /ser sna can rnams 'dul byed pa'i/ /me lce'i sgra ni bsgrub par dka'/ /'joms shing ba sru ldang ba dang / /'jigs par byed cing sdug bsngal byed/ /yang dag sdom dang dka' thub can/ /drang srong rnams la skur 'debs pa/ /de dag spyi'u tshugs dag tu ni / /dmyal bar lhung 9ba dag tu 'gyur/ /'tshed bzhin pa yi nya bzhin du/ /de dag drag pos 'joms shing 'tshed/ /mtshon gyis bcom pa'i klu 3bzhin du/ /de dag rtag tu smre sngags 'don/ /'di ltar nyes par spyod pa rnams/ /'o dod chen pos ⑥smre sngags 'don/ /zhes bka' stsal to / / spyo mngal du 'jug pa gsum dag ces bya ba la'asna/ gleng gzhi spuni mnyan du yod pa na'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bos te/dge slong dag mngal du 'jug pa ni rnam pa gsum ste/ shes bzhin du ma'i mngal du 'jug pa dang / shes bzhin du gnas pa dang / 'byung ba shes bzhin ma yin pa dang / ma'i mngal du 'jug pa shes bzhin du ma yin gyi/ gnas pa dang /'jug pa shes bzhin dang / ma'i mngal du 'jug pa dang / 'byung ba dang /82—325

gnas pa yang shes bzhin du gnas pa yod do zhes gsungs so/ /'di rgyas par nyuni phra rgyas btab mipa'i dbugs 'byung ba drug pa las blta bar bya'o// //'di skad du bcom ldan 'das kyis las ni yod pa rnam par smin pa ni yod do zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ bcom ldan 'das skya bseng gi rngo grong khyer kol ma sha dam mya dze+en bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bos te/ dge slong dag thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/yongs su byang ba tshangs par spyod pa/ gsal bar byed pa/ 'di lta ste/don dam pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs bstan par bya yis de legs par nyon la yid la zung shig hūṃdang bshad par bya'o/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs gang zhe na/ mi skye ba ni gang nas kyang mi 'ong / 'gag pa gang du mi 'gro ste/ dge slong dag 'di ltar mig ni ma byung ba las byung zhing byung nas kyang yongs su 'jig phyapa ste las ni yod do/ /rnam par smin pa ni yod do/ /chos su brdar btags r+ṣa7pa ma gtogs pa phung po 'di 'dor bar byed cing phung po gzhan nying mtshams sbyor bar byed pa po ni mi dmigs so/ /de la chos su brdar btags — —pa ni 'di yin te/ 'di lta ste/'di yod pas 'di 'byung / 'di skyes pa'i phyir 'di skye ste/ 'di lta ste/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed/ 'du byed kyi rkyen gyis rnam par shes pa/ rnam par shes pa'i rkyen gyis ming dang gzugs/ ming dang gzugs kyi rkyen gyis skye mched drug /skye mched drug gi rkyen gyis reg pa/ reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba/tshor ba'i rkyen gyis sred pa/ sred pa'i rkyen gyis len pa/ len pa'i rkyen gyis 82—326

srid pa/ srid pa'i rkyen gyis skye ba/ skye ba'i rkyen gyis rga shi dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de ltar na sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 1'di 'ba' zhig 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar 'di med pas 'di mi 'byung / 'di ma skyes pas 'di 'gag par 'gyur te/ ma rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed 'gag /'du byed 'gags pas rnam par shes pa 'gag /rnam par shes pa 'gags pas ming dang gzugs 'gag /ming dang gzugs 'gags pas skye mched drug 'gag /skye mched drug 'gags pas reg pa 'gag /reg pa 'gags pas tshor ba 'gag /tshor ba 'gags pas sred pa 'gag /sred hūṃpa 'gags zu pas len pa 'gag /len pa 'gags pas srid pa 'gag /srid pa 'gags pas skye ba 'gag /skye ba 'gag zipas rga shi dang / mya ngan —dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams 'gag par 'gyur te/ de ltar na snyug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'di 'ba' zhig 'gag par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni don dam pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs so/ /dge slong dag thog mar dge ba/bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ma 'dres pa/ yongs su sdogs pa/ yongs su byang ba/ tshangs par spyod pa/yongs su gsal bar byed pa 'di lta ste/ don dam pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs bshad par bya'o zhes ji skad du bstan pa de rgyas par bar tu 3bshad do zhes bka' sprul to / /bye dang po nur nur po yin no zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ bcom ldan 'das 82—327

ma ga dhār byeljongs rgyu zhing gshegs te/ gnod sbyin dbang po'i khyim du mtshan mo gnas pa'i phyir gshegs so/ /de nas gnod sbyin dbang po bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der nye bar 'ongs te/ nye bar 'ongs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas gnod sbyin dbang pos tshigs su bcad pa 'di skad ces gsol to/ /srog gis ci zhig mi shes sam/ /srog gis ci zhig mi rtogs sam/ /srog ni gang du bcings shing gnas/ /srog gi 'ching ba sred pa duyin/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sprul pa/ /srog gis gzugs rnams mi shes te/ /'du byed kyang ni rtogs ma yin/ /srog ni lus 'dir bcings rngushing gnas/ /srog ni 'ching ba sred pa yin/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni srog min gsung / /ji ltar tshang tshing 'dir gnas shing / /ji ltar rim gyis gong bur 'gyur/ /ji ltar lus ni ④mngon 'phel 'gyur/ /dang por ⑤nur nur po yin no/ /nur nur po las mer mer po/ /mer mer po las nar nar skye/ /nar nar po las mkhrang 'gyur skye/ /mkhrang las ṣ+yorkang lag 'gyus pa ④dang / /skra spu sen mo la sogs dang / /dbang po gzugs can rnams dang ni/ /mtshan kyebhernams rim gyis skye bar 'gyur/ /gang tshe ma yis 9snabazas pa dang / /btung ba gnyis ka longs spyad pas/ /mngal gyi nang na gnas pa'i mi/ /des ni gso ⑪zhing skye bar 'gyur/ /de nas gnod sbyin dbang po bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga' zhing rjes su yi rang nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi drung nas song ngo / / ⑪'di ltar/ gleng gzhi chen po'i rnam grangs las/ /zhes bya ba la mdor 82—328

bstan pa brjod pa las 'di lhar 'don te/ kun dga' bo ming dang gzugs la rkyen yod dam zhes 'dri na/ byen yod do zhes lan gdab par bya'o/ /kun dga' bo ming dang gzugs kyi rkyen gang yin zhes 'dri na/ rnam par shes pa rkyen yin no zhes brjod par bya'o/ /kun dga' bo rnam par shes pa'i rkyen kyis ming dang gzugs so zhes ngas ji skad du bstan pa de nyurgyas par rab tu bshad do/ /kun dga' bo gal te rnam par shes pa ma'i mngal du zhugs par ma gyur na/ khu ba dang khrag gi nur nur po'i nang du mngon pa/ra brgyal bar 'gyur ram/ btsun pa ma lags so/ /kun dga' bo gal te rnam par shes pa ma'i mngal du zhugs par ma gyur ram tshe/ 'phos par ma gyur na rnam par shes pa 'di lta bur nye bar 1'gyur ram/ btsun pa ma lags so/ /kun dga' bo gal te byis pa dang /gzhon nu dang gzhon nu ma da' / lang tsho'i gnas skabs kyi ghurnam par shes pa dang po nas 'di ltar chad cing ma byung bar gyur na ming dang gzugs 'di ltar rgyas shing yangs pa thu rgya chen por 'gyur ram/ btsun pa ma lags so/ /kun dga' bo gal te rnam pa thams cad du rnam par shes pa med na ming dang gzugs gdags par nus sam/ btsun pa ma lags so/ /sgokun dga' bo de'i phyir rgyu mtshan 'di dang / rgyu 'di dang / kun 'byung ba 'di lta ste/ rnam par shes pa'i rkyen gyis ming dang gzugs zhes bya'o/ /rnam nga ra shes pa'i rkyen kyis ming dang gzugs zhes ngas spruji be+ed du bstan pa de rgyas par rab tu bshad do/ /'di ltar mdo de nyid las dge slong dag dke slong gis gang phan chad rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang zhes bya ba la gogs pa la/ gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na'o/ /dge slong dag rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba dang / rten 82—329

cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i chos rnams bshad par bya yis de legs par nyon la yid la zung shig tshidang bshad par bya'o/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i chos rnams gang zhe na/ 'di ltar 'di yod pas 'di 'byung / 'di skyes pa'i phyir 'di skye ste/ 'di ltar ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed rnams zhes bya ba nas/'di 'ba' zhig kun du 'byung bar 'gyur zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ skye ba'i rkyen gyis rga shi zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyebyung yang rung / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ma byung yang rung ba 'di ni chos nyid do/ /chos rnams kyi chos nyid 'di ni rtag tu gnas pa'o zhes rang nyid kyi mngon par shes pas mkhyen cing mngon par sangs rgyas nas ston par byed/ 'chad par byed/ rab tu 'chad par byed/ rnam par 'byed par byed/ 'grel par byed/ rgyas par byed/ston cing yang dag par gsal bar byed de/ 'di ltar skye ba'i rkyen kyis rga shi dang / srid pa dang / len pa dang / sred pa dang / tshor ba dang /reg pa dang / skye mched drug dang / ming dang gzugs dang / rnam par shes pa dang / ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed rnams te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung ngam ma byung yang rung chos nyid de/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid 'di ni rtag tu gnas so zhes de bzhin gshegs pas rang nyid kyi mngon par shes pas mkhyen nas mngon par sangs rgyas nas ston par byed/ 'chad par byed/rab tu 'chad par byed/ rnam par 'byed par byed/ 'grel par byed/rgyas par byed/ ston sgo cing yang dag par gsal bar byed de/ 'di ltar ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed rnams zhes bya ba 'di ni chos rnams kyi gnas pa/chos rnams kyi nges pa/ chos rnams kyi ji lta ba nyid/ de bzhin nyid/ mi 82—330

'gyur ba de bzhin nyid/ gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid ji lta ba/ bden pa/de kho na nyid/ ji lta ba bzhin mi 'gyur ba/ phyin ci ma log pa/ rkyen 'di tsam pa ste/ 'di ni rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba go rims las bzlog 1pa ste/'di ni rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i chos rnams gang zhe na/ ma rig pa dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa dang / ming dang gzugs dang / skye mched drug dang / reg pa dang /tshor ba dang / sred pa dang / len pa dang / srid pa dang / skye ba dang /rga shi'o/ /dge slong dag de la skye ba dang / rga shi ni mi rtag pas ldu'adus byas bsags pa/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba/ skye ba dang / 'jig pa'i chos can/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i chos can/ 'gag pa'i chos can du de ltar yongs su shes par bya'o/ /skye ba dang / srid pa dang / len pa dang /sred pa dang / tshor ba dang / reg pa dang / skye mched drug dang / ming dang gzugs dang / rnam par shes pa dang / 'du byed kyang mi rtag pa/'du byas pa/ bsags pa/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba/ skye ba dang /'jig pa'i chos can/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i chos can/ 'gog pa'i chos can du de yongs su shes par bya ste/ 'di ni rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /dge slong dag gang yang 'phags pa nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa/rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i chos rnams yang dag pa'i 1 shes rab kyis 4ji lta ba bzhin shes shing / rab tu mthong zhing bar blutu rig la/ rab tu rten cing rab tu yid la byas shing /legs par so sor rtogs na/ de ci snebadag 'das pa'i dus na byung bar gyur 82—331

tam nyu'on te byung bar ma gyur/ bdag 'das pa'i dus na ci zhig tu 1byung bar gyur/ bdag 'das pa'i dus na ji ltar byung bar gyur zhes sngon gyi mtha' rjes su 'brang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /ci bdag ma 'ongs pa'i dus na 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ 'on te bdag ma 'ongs pa'i dus na 'byung bar mi 'gyur/bdag ma 'ongs pa'i dus na ci zhig tu da'abyung bar 'gyur/ bdag ma 'ongs pa'i dus na ji ltar 'byung bar 'gyur zhes phyi ma mtha'i rjes su 'brang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'di ci zhig 'di ji ltar yod pa ni ci zhig 'byung bar ③ni ci zhig sems can 'di dag gang nas 'ongs shing 'chi 'pho ba na gang du 'gro bar 'gyur zhes nang gi bdag nyid la je tshom za bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang yang dge sbyong ngam bram ze gang kha cig 'jig rten gyi lta bar gyur pa tha dad pa 'di lta ste/ bdag tu smra ba dang / yang dag par ldan pa dang / mtshams sbyor bar ⑤ byed par smra ba dang / yang dag par ldan pa dang / gso bar smra ba dang yang dag par ldan pa dang / dge mtshan dang bkra shis su smra ba dang yang dag par ldan pa dag de'i tshe na yongs su shes shing yongs su spangs par 'gyur/ rtsa ba bcad par 'gyur te / shing ta la rtsa ba bcad pa ltar ma 'ongs pa'i skal ba mi skye ba'i chos can du 'gyur te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge slong dag 'di ltar 'phags pa nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i chos rnams yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis ji lta ba bzhin shes shing rab tu mthong zhing rab tu rig la rab tu yid la byas shing / rab tu rten la legs par so sor rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /dge slong dag rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i chos rnams bstan par bya'o 82—332

zhes ji skad du bstan pa de rgyas par rab tu bshad do zhes bka' sprul to/ /ma rig pa tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa rgyu can du gsungs zhes bya ba la/ bcom ldan 'das skya bseng gi rmyegrong khyer kol ma sha dam mya na bzhugs te / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bos te/ dge slong dag thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba zhes bya ba nas tshangs par spyod pa yongs su gsal bar byed pa 'di lta ste/ rgyu dang bcas rkyen dang bcas rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs bshad par bya yis de legs par zhes bya ba nas bshad par bya ba'i bar du'o/ /dge slong dag rgyu dang bcas rkyen dang bcas rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs gang zhe na/dge slong dag mig ni rgyu dang bcas rkyen dang bcas rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa ste/dge slong dag mig gi rgyu ni gang / rkyen ni gang / rgyu mtshan ni gang zhe na/dge slong dag las ni rgyu/ las ni rkyen/ las ni rgyu mtshan no/ /dge slong dag las ni rgyu dang bcas rkyen dang bcas rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa'o/ /dge slong dag las kyi rgyu ni gang / rkyen ni gang / rgyu mtshan ni gang zhe na/ dge slong dag las kyi rgyu ni sred pa/ rkyen ni sred pa/ rgyu mtshan ni sred pa'o/ /dge slong dag sred pa yang rgyu dang bcas/ rkyen dang bcas/ rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa ste/ dge slong dag sred pa'i rgyu ni gang / rkyen ni gang / rgyu mtshan ni gang zhe na/ dge slong dag sred pa'i rgyu ni ma rig pa/ rkyen ni ma rig pa rgyu mtshan ni ma rig pa'o/ /dge slong dag ma rig pa yang rgyu dang bcas rkyen dang bcas/ rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa ste/ dge slong dag ma rig pa'i rgyu ni gang / rkyen ni gang / rgyu mtshan ni gang zhe na/ dge slong dag ma rig 82—333

pa'i rgyu ni tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa/ rkyen ni tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa/ rgyu mtshan ni tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa'o/ /dge slong dag tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa hūṃrgyu dang bcas/ rkyen dang bcas / rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa'o/ /dge slong dag tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa'i rgyu ni gang / rkyen ni gang / rgyu mtshan ni gang zhe na/ ming dang gzugs la brten nas ma rig pa las skyes pa yid la byed pa rnyog pa skyes te/gang rmongs shing kun du rmongs rngul ma rig pa de sred ༷ ne+epa don du gnyer ro/ /sred pa dang bcas nas rnam par rig byed kyi las byed de/ dge slong dag tshul bzhin ma yin pa 3yid la byed pa ni ma rig pa'i rgyu can ma rig pa ni sred pa'i rgyu can/ sred pa ni las kyi rgyu can/ las ni mig gi rgyu can no/ /dge slong dag rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyang rgyu dang bcas / rkyen dang bcas/ rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa ste/ dge slong dag yid kyi rgyu ni gang / rkyen ni gang / rgyu mtshan ni gang zhe na/ dge slong dag yid kyi rgyu ni las/ rkyen ni las/ rgyu mtshan ni las so/ /dge slong dag las kyang rgyu dang bcas/ rkyen dang bcas/ rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa ste/dge slong dag las kyi rgyu ni gang / rkyen ni gang / rgyu mtshan ni gang zhe na/dge slong dag las kyi rgyu ni sred pa/ rkyen ni sred pa/ rgyu mtshan ni sred pa'o/ /dge slong dag sred pa yang rgyu dang bcas 3/ rkyen dang bcas/ rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa ste/ dge slong dag sred pa'i rgyu ni gang / rkyen ni gang / rgyu mtshan ni gang zhe na/ dge slong dag sred pa'i rgyu ni ma rig pa/ rkyen ni ma rig pa/ rgyu mtshan ni ma rig pa'o/ /dge slong dag ma rig pa 3rgyu dang bcas/82—334

rkyen dang bcas/ rgyu tūmatshan dang bcas pa ste/ dge slong dag ma rig pa'i rgyu dang / rkyen dang / rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa ni rgyu'o/ /tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa ni rkyen sgo no/ /tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa ni rgyu mtshan no/ /dge slong dag tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa yang rgyu dang bcas/ tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa zhe yang rkyen dang bcas/ tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa yang rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa ste/ dge slong dag tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa'i rgyu ni gang / rkyen ni gang / rgyu mtshan ni gang zhe na/ dge slong dag yid dang /chos la brten nas ma rig pa las skyes pa'i jeyid la byed pa rnyog pa skyes te/gang rmongs shing kun du rmongs la/ ma rig pa de sred pa don du gnyer ro/ /sred pa dang bcas na rnam par rig byed (kyi las byed de/ dge slong dag tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa ni ma rig pa'i rgyu can/ ma rig pa ni sred pa'i rgyu can/ sred pa ni las kyi rgyu can/ las ni mig gi rgyu can te/ 'di ni rgyu dang bcas/ rkyen dang bcas/ rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs te/ dge slong dag rgyu dang bcas/ rkyen dang bcas/ rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa'i chos bshad par bya ste zhes bya ba nas/ snga ma bzhin du rgyu dang bcas/ rkyen dang bcas/5 rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa'i 7chos bshad par bya'o zhes ngas ji skad du bstan pa de rgyas par rab tu bshad do zhes bka' stsal to/ /mdo gzhan las ma rig pa'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba zhes bya ba la phung po'i sngon gyi tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa'i dang po'i mdo mdzod kyi gnas gnyis par mi ldan pa'i 'du byed kyi 8'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i skabs su 82—335

bris pa blta bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis khyed la rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba'i chos rnams kyang bshad par bya'o zhes bka' sprul to kyezhes bya ba ni snga ma bzhin du de ma thag kho nar kyedage slong dag khyed da 1la rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i chos rnam par bshad par bya zhes mdo bris pa blta bar bya'o/ /'di ni mdo'i don ma yin no zhes bya ba la sogs pa la gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bos te/dge slong dag rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i thog ma phyodang / rnam par dbye ba bshad par bya yis de legs par nyon la yid la zung shig phyodang bshad par bya'o / /rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba'i dang po gang zhe na/ 'di yod pas 'di 'byung / 'di skyes pa'i phyir 'di skye ste/ 'di ltar ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed dang / 'du byed kyi dz+warkyen gyis rnam par shes pa༄ ༷/ rnam par shes pa'i rkyen gyis ming dang gzugs/ ming dang gzugs kyi rkyen gyis skye mched drugaskye mched drug gi rkyen gyis reg pa/ reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba/ tshor ba'i rkyen gyis sred pa/ sred pa'i rkyen gyis len pa/ len pa'i rkyen gyis srid pa/srid pa'i rkyen gyis skye ba/ skye ba'i rkyen gyis rga shi dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams kun du 'byung bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag de ltar na sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'di 'ba' zhig kun du 'byung bar 'gyur te/ 'di ni rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i dngos po zhes bya'o/ /rnam par dbye ba gang zhe na/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed ces 'byung ba ma rig pa shā— bhegang zhe na/ sngon gyi 82—336

mtha' mi shes pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' mi shes pa dang / sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' mi shes pa dang / nang mi shes pa dang / phyi mi shes pa dang / nang dang phyi rol mi shes pa dang / las mi shes pa dang / rnam par smin pa mi shes pa dang / las kyi rnam par smin pa mi shes pa dang / rgyu mi shes pa dang /'bras bu mi shes pa dang / rgyu dang 'bras bu mi shes pa dang / sangs rgyas mi shes pa dang / chos mi shes pa dang / dge 'dun mi shes pa dang / sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung dang / 'gog pa dang / lam mi shes pa dang /rgyu las byung ba'i chos rnams mi shes pa dang / dge ba dang mi dge ba shernams dang / kha na ma tho ba 1dang bcas pa dang / kha na ma tho ba med pa rnams dang / brten 1par bya ba dang / brten ④par bya ba ma yin pa rnams dang /spang bya dang spang bya ma yin pa rnams dang / dkar po dang / nag po rnams dang / rnam par dbye ba dang bcas pa'i rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i chos rnams mi shes pa dang / 'di ltar reg pa'i skye mched drug 'di ltar yang dag pa tre ji lta ba bzhin so sor ma rig pa ste/ gang yang de dang de la mi shes pa dang /ma mthong ba dang / mngon par ma rtogs trepa dang / mun pa dang / rmongs pa ma rig pa'i mun pa zhes bya ba ste 'di ni ma rig pa zhes bya'o/ /ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed gang zhe na/ 'du byed ni rnam pa gsum ste/ lus kyi 'du byed dang / ngag gi 'du byed dang / yid kyi 'du byed do/ /'du byed kyi rkyen gyis rnam par shes pa zhes 'byung ba rnam par shes pa gang zhe na/ rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug ste/ mig gi rnam par shes pa dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa'o/ /rnam par 82—337

shes pa'i rkyen kyis ming dang gzugs zhes byung ba ming gang zhe na/ gzugs can ma yin pa'i phung po bzhi ste/ tshor ba'i phung po dang / 'du shes kyi phung po dang / 'du byed kyi phung po dang / rnam par shes pa'i phung po'o/ /gzugs gang zhe na/ gzugs gang ci yang rung ba de thams cad ni 'byung ba chen po bzhi dag dang / 'byung ba chen po bzhi dag rgyur byas pa ste/ gzugs 'di dang sngar bstan pa thams cad gcig tu bsdus te ming dang gzugs zhes bya'o/ /ming dang gzugs kyi rkyen gyis skye mched drug ces 'byung ba skye mched drug gang zhe na / nang gi skye mched drug ste/ mig hūṃnang gi skye mched dang / rna ba dang /sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid nang gi skye mched do/ /skye mched drug gi snyerkyen gyis reg pa zhes 'byung ba reg pa gang zhe na/ reg pa'i chos sde drug ste/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang /lus dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'o/ /reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba zhes 'byung ba tshor ba gang zhe na/ tshor ba gsum ste/ bde ba dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / bde ba yang ma yin/ sdug bsngal ba yang ma yin pa'o/ /tshor ba'i rkyen kyis sred pa zhes 'byung ba sred pa gang zhe na/ sred pa gsum 3ste/'dod pa'i sred pa dang / gzugs kyi sred pa dang / gzugs rnged pa'i sred pa'o / /sred pa'i rkyen gyis len pa zhes 'byung ba len pa gang zhe na/ nye bar len pa bzhi ste/ 'dod pa nye bar len pa dang / lta ba nye bar len pa dang /tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs nye bar len pa dang / bdag tu smra ba 6nye bar len pa'o/ /len pa'i rkyen gyis srid pa zhes 'byung ba srid pa gang zhe na/srid pa rnam pa gsum ste/ 'dod pa'i srid pa dang 3/ gzugs kyi srid pa 82—338

—dang / gzugs med pa'i srid pa'o/ /srid pa'i rkyen gyis skye ba zhes 'byung ba skye ba gang zhe na/ sems can de dang de dag sems can gyi ris 1mthun pa de dang der skye zhing yang dag par skye ba dang / 'jug pa dang / mngon par grub pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang / phung po thob cing kham sa dang skye mched thob la/phung po mngon par grub cing dbang po dang grong mngon par rab tu byung ba ste 'di ni skye ba zhes bya'o/ /skye ba'i rkyen gyis rga shi zhes 2 'byung ba rga shi gang zhe na/gang spyi jer dang /bye skra dkar dang / 'khyogs 4shing gnyer ma mang ba dang / sgur po sgu 3bo/ gre ba sgra ngar ngar pos 'gags pa/ lus sgu 6zhing 'khar ba la brten pa/ sme ba'i thig les lus nyams pa/ lus bcings shing bcings pa dang / dbang po rnams yongs su nyams shing yongs su smin pa dang / 'jig pa dze+edang 'du byed rnams yongs su rnyings 3shing rgas par gyur pa rngu'adi ni rga ba zhes bya'o/ /'chi ba gang zhe na/ sems can gyi skal pa mnyam pa de dang de las 'chi 'pho zhing 'jig la nub byung tshe dang drod nyams la 1 phung po 'phos shing dbang po rnams 'gags te/ shi zhing dus byed par 'gyur ba 'di ni 'chi ba zhes bya nyu1ste/ 'chi ba 'di dang rga ba gnyis ga nyurtagacig tu bsdus nas rga shi zhes bya'o/ /'di ni rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba'i rnam par dbye ba zhes bya'o/ /dge slong dag khyed la rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba'i dang po dang rnam par dbye ba bshad par she5bya'o zhes ji skad du bstan pa de rgyas par rab tu bshad do/ /'di lta ste glang po'i rjes lta bu'i mdo las zhes bya ba la/ glang po'i rjes lta bu'i mdo bar ma'i bdun po tha ma las bstan pa mdzod kyi nyubye gnas dang por blta bar bya'o/ /der bstan pa phyogs tsam 'di ltar 'don te/ sa'i khams 82—339

gang zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa dag sa'i khams ni rnam pa gnyis te/ nang dang phyi rol gyi'o/ /nang gi sa'i khams kyang yod do/ /nang gi sa'i khams gang zhe na—/ gang yang lus 'di la nang gi bdag nyid kyi sra ba dang kye/ mkhrang ba dang / zin pa dang / zin par gyur pa ste/ de gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/skra dang / spu dang / sen mo dang / so dang / rdul dang / dri ma dang /pags pa dang / sha dang / rus pa dang / rtsa dang / rgyus pa dang /snying dang / glo ba dang / mchin pa dang / mkhal ma dang / rgyu ma dang /gnye ma dang / pho ba dang / long ka dang / gang rags par gyur pa ste/gang lus 'di la sra ba dang / mkhrang ba zin pa dang / zin par gyur pa 'di ni nang gi bdag nyid kyi sa'i khams zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung yang rung ma byung yang rung zhes bya ba la/gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na'o/ /de nas dge slong gzhan zhig bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der nye bar 'ongs te/ nye bar 'ongs nas zhes bya ba nas/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /ci bcom ldan 'das kyis rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba byas sam/ 'on te gzhan zhig gis byas/ dge slong rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba ni ngas kyang ma byas la/gzhan gyis kyang ma byas kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung yang rung ma byung yang rung / chos rnams kyi chos nyid 'di ni gnas pa/ chos kyi dbyings te/de bzhin gshegs pa rang nyid kyis mkhyen cing mngon par sangs rgyas nas 'chad par byed/ ston par byed/ rnam par 'byed par byed/ 'byel pa dang ston ( cing yang dag par gsal bar byed de3/ 'di lta ste 'di yod pas 'di 'byung /82—340

'di skyes pas 'di skye ste/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed/ 'du byed kyi rkyen gyis rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba nas snga ma bzhin du/ 'di 'ba' zhig kun du 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /'di ltar 'di rnged pas 'di mi 'byung / 'di 'gags pas 'di 'gag par rmye'agyur te/ 'di ltar ma rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed 'gag ces bya ba nas skye ba dang rga shi 'gag par 'gyur zhes bya ba'i bar du'o zhes bka' stsal to/ /dper na gzhan las ma rig pa yod na 'du byed rnams 'byung gi 3gzhan du ma rig pa'i rkyen med par 'du byed rnams ma yin na zhes bya ba la yang dag par —ldan pa'i gleng gzhi las dang ldan pa dang / 'bras 4bu can zhes bya ba'i sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa gsum pa'i mdo sa can las 'di ltar 'don to phye/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa'i don bdag gis 'tshal ba ltar na skye ba yod na rga shi 'byung bar 'gyur kyikye/ gzhan du na skye ba'i rkyen med par rga shi 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /skye ba dang / srid pa dang / len pa dang / sred pa dang / tshor ba dang / reg pa dang / skye mched drug dang /ming dang gzugs dang / rnam par shes pa dang / ma rig pa yod na 'du byed 'byung bar 'gyur gyi/ gzhan du na ma rig pa med par 'du byed rnams 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa skye ba med na rga shi 'byung bar mi 'gyur gyi/gzhan du na skye ba 'gags pas rga shi 'gag par mi 'gyur ro/ /skye ba dang srid pa dang / len pa dang / sred pa dang / tshor ba dang / reg pa dang /skye mched drug dang / ming dang gzugs dang / rnam par shes pa dang / ma 82—341

rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed 'gag par 'gyur gyi/ gzhan du na ma rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed 'gag par mi 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo de de bzhin te/de de bzhin no/ /skye ba yod na rga shi 'byung bar hūṃ'agyur gyi/ gzhan du na rnguskye ba med na rga shi 'byung bar mi 'gyur te zhes bya ba nas snga ma bzhin du ma rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed 'gag par 'gyur zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /lta ba drug cu rtsa gnyis ni tshangs pa'i dra ba las ji skad du 'byung ba bzhin te zhes bya ba la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa zhe dus gcig na bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum dang / dge bsnyen stong dang / slong 4mo za ba lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu ma ga dhā na pyeljongs rgyu zhing gshegs te/ rgyal po'i khab dang pa ṭa hūṃli'i grong khyer gyi bar na rgyal po bzhugs sa 7smyug ma'i ldum bu can du mtshan mo bzhugs pa'i phyir gshegs so/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na kun du rgyu rab dga' zhes bya ba rnam grangs du mas sangs rgyas kyi bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod chos dang dge 'dun kyi bsngags pa ma yin pa rjod kyipar byed do/ /kun du rgyu rab dga'i lhan cig gnas pa tshangs pas byin zhes bya ba rnam grangs du mas sangs rgyas kyi bsngags pa brjod/ chos dang dge 'dun kyi bsngags pa brjod de/ slob dpon dang nye bar gnas pa 'di gnyis ka kya/nga lta ba gzhan dang gzhan du gyur cing / 'dod pa dang blo tha dad par smra ba yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi phyi bzhin du 'brang bar gyur to/ /de nas dge slong rab tu mang po rgyal po bzhugs sa na 'dus par gyur cing 'dug pa de dag bar skabs su 'di lta bu'i gtam gleng 9langs te/ tshe dang ldan pa dag sems can 82—342

rnams kyi mos pa sna tshogs pa ni ngo mtshar te/ gang gi phyir da ltar kun du rgyu rab dga' sangs rgyas kyi bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod/ chos dang dge 'dun kyi bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod la zhes bya ba nas dge 'dun gyi bsngags pa brjod ces bya ba'i bar du'o/ /dge slong rab tu mang po rgyal po bzhugs sa na 'dus par gyur ces 'dug pa de dag 'di lta bu'i gtam brjod pa/ bcom ldan 'das nyin par gyi gnas pas bzhugs pas nyulha'i rna ba shin tu rnam par dag pa mi las 'das pas gsan to/ /gsan nas rgyal po bzhugs sa gang na ba der nye bar gshegs te dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi dbus su gdan bshams pa la bzhugs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bos te dge slong dag dge slong rab tu mang po rgyal po bzhugs sa na 'dus par gyur cing 'dug pa dag bar skabs su gtam brjod pa ci lta bu gleng langs/ don ci'i phyir 'dus par gyur cing 'dug par gyur/ btsun pa bdag cag 'di na dge slong rab tu mang po dag rgyal po 2bzhugs sa na 'dus par gyur cing 'dug pa dag bar skabs su 'di lta bu'i gtam brjod pa gleng langs te/ sems can rnams kyi mos pa sna tshogs pa ni ngo mtshar te/ gang gi phyir da ltar kun du rgyu rab dga' sangs rgyas kyi bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod la/ chos dang dge 'dun kyi bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod ces bya ba nas dge 'dun gyi bsngags pa brjod ces bya ba'i bar du dang /'di lta bu bdag cag ces snga ma bzhin no/ /dge slong dag nga'i bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod pa dang / chos dang dge 'dun kyi bsngags pa ma yin pa rjod 1/par byed pa de la khyed cag mi bzod par mi bya ba dang / ma dad pa dang sems mi dga' bar mi bya ba ste/ dge slong dag nga'i bsngags pa ma yin pa 82—343

brjod / chos dang dge 'dun gyi bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod pa de la khyed cag mi bzod pa dang / ma dad pa dang / sems mngon par mi dga' bar gyur na de nyid spyod cag gi bar du gcod par 'gyur te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/dge slong de srid du khro ba dang gtum par 'gyur zhing yid du mi 'ong bar 'gyur te/gzhan kyis smras shepa'i don rnam pa thams cad du khyeyongs su rdzogs par shes pa dang mthong bar 'gyur ba 'di ni gnas ma yin zhing go skabs med do/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na de'i phyir nga'i bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod pa dang /chos dang dge 'dun gyi bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod pa yang dag pa ni yang zudag pa nyid du shes par bya zhing / 'di ni yang dag pa ma yin pa 'di lta bu ni yang dag pa ma yin pa ste/ bdag cag la chos 'di med do zhes yang dag pa ma yin pa ni yang dag pa ma yin pa'o zhes yongs su spang thubar bya'o/ /dge slong dag nga'i bsngags pa brjod pa dang / chos dang dge 'dun gyi bsngags pa rjod kye par byed pa na de la khyed dga' ba dang / yid bde ba dang / sems yeng yeng por mi bya ste/ dge slong dag nga'i bsngags pa brjod pa dang / chos dang dge 'dun gyi bsngags pa rjod par byed tshipa de la khyed cag dga' ba dang /yid bde ba dang / sems yeng yeng por 7byed na/ de nyid khyed cag gi sre bar du gcod par 'gyur te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge slong dag de de srid du dga' ba skye ba dang / yid bde ba gye ba dang / sems yeng yeng por gyur na 9bhegazhan gyis smras pa ni don thams cad yongs su rdzogs par shes pa dang mthong bar 'gyur ba 'di ni gnas ma yin zhing go skabs med do/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na de'i phyir nga'i bsngags pa brjod pa dang / chos dang dge 82—344

'dun kyi bsngags pa brjod pa na she'adi ni yang dag pa 'di lta bu ni yang dag pa ste chos 'di dag grubadag cag ldan no drozhes yang dag pa ni yang dag par shes par bya zhing yang dag pa ma yin pa ni yang dag pa ma yin pa'o zhes yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /byis pa so so'i skye bo chothos pa dang mi ldan pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsngags pa brjod cing smra ba 'di ni shin tu chung ste/ 'di lta ste/ tshul khrims tsam la'am/ 'dod pa las dbe+en pa tsam la'o/ /ji choltar na tshul khrims tsam la zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das ni tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ tshul khrims rdzogs pa ji skad smras pa de bzhin du byed pa/ ji ltar byed pa de bzhin du smra ba byuzhes bya ba dang / bcom ldan 'das de ni srog gcod pa spangs shing srog gcod pa las log rtsopa dbyug pa dang mtshon cha gespangs pa zhes bya ba nas rgyas par dpe'i bar du dang / tshul khrims kyi phung po zhes bya ba nas phyi nas rnam par smin par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ 'di ltar tshul khrims tsam la'o—/ /ji ltar kyedabe+en pa la zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de ni 'phags pa'i tshul khrims kyi phung po 'di dang ldan pas de dbang po'i sgo bsrungs shing gnas zhes bya ba nas dbang po'i sdom pa dang ldan pa de 'phags pa'i tshul khrims kyi phung po 'di dang ldan pas gshegs pa dang byon pa shes bzhin du nyu bzhugs shing /gzigs pa dang / rnam par gzigs pa dang / gzims kyis ngal ba bsang ba dag la mi mkhyen bzhin du bzhugs zhes bya ba nas bsam gtan bzhi pa nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /'di lta bu ni 'dod pa las dbe+en pa'o / /dge slong dag gzhan yang chos zab mo zab par snang ba/ yongs su dag pa yongs su byang ba de dag ni rang nyid kyis mngon par mkhyen cing mngon 82—345

par sangs rgyas nas bstan 2cing bshad pas gzhan gyis de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag pa ji lta ba 1bzhin kyi bsngags pa brjod cing smra bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag dge sbyong ngam bram ze gang kha cig sngon gyi mthar rtog cing rtag par smra ba dag bdag dang 'jig rten ni rtag pa'o zhes mngon par smra bas mngon par smra ba dag yod de/ 'de lta ste dngos po bzhi rnams la'o/ /dge slong dag bram ze de dag gang rtogs shing gang la brten te gang dmigs nas/ sngon gyi mthar rtog cing rtag par smra ba dag 'di ltar dngos po bzhi rnams la bdag dang 'jig rten ni rtag pa'o zhes mngon par smra bas mngon par smra ba dag 'byung zhe na / dge slong dag 'di na dge spyong ngam bram ze kha cig dgon pa'am shing drung ngam/ khang pa stong pa yongs su gdung ba'i rgyu dang / spangs pa'i rgyu dang /bsgoms pa'i rgyu dang / lan mang du byas pa'i rgyu dang / yang dag par yid la byas pa'i rgyu dang / 'di lta bu'i sems zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gyur te/ji ltar sems mnyam par gzhag pa la 'jig pa dang chags 5pa'i bar gyi bskal pa nyi shu rjes su dran te/ de 'di snyam du bdag dang 'jig rten ni rtag pa'o/ /bdag dang 'jig rten rtag pa ni de kho na ltar 'gyur te/ bdag dgon pa'am shing drung ngam khang pa stong par zhes bya ba nas 'jig pa dang chags pa'i bar gyi bskal pa nyi shu rjes su dran te bdag dang 'jig rten ni rtag pa ma song 6ba mi 'gro ba gnod pa byar med pa/ rtag tu gnas pa rdo rje ltar gnas pa'o/ /sems can byung bar gyur pa 'di dag nyid nying mtshams sbyor zhing 'khor te 7rtag pa dang mnyam pa 'di med do zhes bya bar 'gyur te/ dge slong 'di ni dngos po dang po ste gang rtogs shing gang la brten te gang dmigs pas sngon gyi mthar rtog 82—346

cing rtag par smra ba dag bdag dang 'jig rten ni lkurtag pa'o zhes mngon par smra bas mngon par smra ba'o/ /dge slong thungam bram ze gzhan pa yang gang rtogs shing gang la brten te gang dmigs nas sngon gyi mthar rtog cing rtag par smra ba dag bdag dang 'jig rten rtag pa'o zhes mngon par smra bas mngon par smra zhe na / dge sbyong dag 'di na dge spyong dang bram ze kha cig ston pa'am/ shing drung ngam khang pa stong par yongs su gdung ba'i rgyu dang / spangs pa'i rgyu dang /bsgoms pa'i rgyu dang / lan bye mang du byas pa'i rgyu dang / yang dag par yid la byas pa'i rgyu dang thulas de lta bu'i sems zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gyur te/ji ltar sems mnyam par gzhag pa na 'jig pa dang / chags pa'i bar gyi bskal pa bzhi bcu yongs su dran nas/ de 'di snyam du bdag dang 'jig rten ni rtag pa'o / /bdag dang 'jig rten rtag pa ni de kho na ltar 'gyur te zhes bya ba nas snga ma bzhin du 'jig pa dang chags pa'i bar gyi 5bskal pa bzhi bcu rjes su dran te / bdag dang 'jig rten ni ma song ba mi 'gro ba gnod pa byar med pa rtag tu gnas shing rdo rje ltar gnas pa'i sems can byung bar gyur pa 'di dag nyid nying mtshams spyor zhing 'khod de rtag pa dang mnyam pa ni med do zhes bya bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag 'di ni dngos po gnyis pa zhes bya ba nas snga ma bzhin du mngon par smra bas mngon par smra'o zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /dge spyong ngam bram ze gzhan gsum pa yang gang 4rtogs shing gang la brten te gang dmigs nas sngon rtsegyi mthar rtog pa rtag par smra ba dang zhes ri —bya ba nas snga ma bzhin du ji ltar sems mnyam par gzhag na 'jig pa dang chags (pa'i bar gyi bskal pa brgyad cu rjes su dran nas/ de 'di snyam du bdag dang 'jig rten rtag pa ste de 82—347

ni de kho na ltar 'gyur te zhes bya ba nas rtag pa dang / mnyam pa gzhan med do zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ dge slong dag 'di ni dngos po gsum pa ste/ gang rtogs shing gang la brten hūṃte/ gang dmigs nas sngon gyi mthar rtog pa rtag par smra ba dag bdag dang 'jig rten ni rtag pa'o zhes mngon par smra bas mngon par smra ba'o/ /dge sbyong ngam bram ze gzhan zhig bzhi pa yang gang rtogs shing gang la brten te/ gang dmigs nas sngon gyi mtha' la rtog pa rtag par smra ba dag ces bya ba nas snga ma bzhin sems mnyam par gzhag pa ni mi las 'das pa'i lha'i mig rnam par dag pas sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho ba dang / skye ba dang /kha dog bzang po dang / kha dog ngan pa dang / dman pa dang / gya nom pa dang / bde 'gror 'gro ba dang / bzang 'gror 'gro ba dag mthong nas de 'di snyam du bdag dang 'jig rten ni rtag pa'o/ /bdag dang 'jig rten rtag pa ni de kho na ltar 'gyur te/ bdag dgon pa'am shing drung ngam khang pa stong par 3zhes bya ba nas sems mnyam ༷par gzhag pa na mi las 'das pa'i lha'i mig rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba nas ngan 'gror 'go ba yang mthong zhes bya ba'i bar du bdag dang 'jig rten ni song zhing mi 'gro ba/ gnod pa byar ④med cing rtag tu gnas shing rdo rje ltar gnas pa'i sems can 'di dag nyid nying mtshams spyor zhing 'khor te/ rtag pa dang mnyam pa med do zhes bya bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag 'di ni dngos po bzhi pa ste gang rtogs shing gang la brten te/ gang dmigs nas sngon gyi mtha' la rtog pa rtag par smra ba dag bdag snye'ajig rten ni rtag pa'o zhes mngon par smra bas mngon par smra ba'o5/ /dge slong 3ngam bram ze gang kha cig sngon gyi mthar rtog pa rtag khyepar smra ba dag bdag dang 'jig rten 82—348

ni rtag pa'o zhes mngon par smra bas mngon par smra ba de thams cad ni dngos po bzhi po 'di dag las gong mar gyur pa med cing mi 'byung ngo / /de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pas yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin rab tu mkhyen te/ 'di dag ni lta bar gyur pa 'di lta bu 'dzin pa bsam pa 'di lta bu 'gro ba/ 'di lta bu skye ba 'di lta bu 'jig rten pha rol po 'di lta bu zhes de bzhin gshegs pas zhes yang dag pa k+ṇiji lta ba bzhin rab tu mkhyen te/ 'di dang 'di las gong mar gyur pa yang de bzhin gshegs pas yang dag pa 3 ji lta ba bzhin rab tu mkhyen nas rnam par mi dpyod mi rtog cing bdag nyid so sor ma grub pa zhes rtogs shing tshor ba'i kun 'byung ba dang / skye ba mkhyen cing / 'di rgo sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba mkhyen par gyur to/ /dge spyong dag 'di ni chos zab mo zab par snang ba zhes bya ba nas snga ma bzhin du dge spyong dag ces bya ba'i bar du'o/ /dge sbyong dag ④bram ze kha cig sngon gyi mthar rtog pa rtag par smra ba dag bdag dang 'jig rten ni rtag pa'o zhes mngon par 7smra ba dag yod de/ 'di lta ste dngos po bzhi rnams la'o/ /dge sbyong ngam bram ze dag gang rtogs shing gang la brten te gang dmigs nas sngon kyi mthar rtog pa phyogs gcig rtag trepar smra ba dag 'di ltar dngos po bzhi pa rnams la bdag dang 'jig rten phyogs gcig rtag pa'o zhes mngon par smra bas mngon par smra ba dag 'byung bar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong dag 'jig rten 'di 'jig cing 'jig par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i dus kyang yod de3/'jig rten 'jig pa na sems can phal cher 'od gsal gyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye bar 'gyur te/ der yid las byung ba'i gzugs can dang (she dbang po tshang zhing nyams shepa med pa yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang 82—349
